parties.binding_yaml:
doubleblind_binding: '1.0'
side: consumer
base_url: "${CONSUMER_BASE_URL}"
webhook_receiver_url: "${CONSUMER_BASE_URL}/__test/webhook"
app:
  manage: true
  start: "python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port ${CONSUMER_PORT}"
  cwd: "."
  env:
    DOUBLEBLIND_TEST_HOOKS: "1"
    PRINTHOUSE_BASE_URL: "{{stub.url}}"
    PRINTHOUSE_API_KEY: "{{secrets.partner_api_key}}"
    PRINTHOUSE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: "{{secrets.webhook_secret}}"
  healthcheck: { method: GET, path: /health }
actions:
  reset: { method: POST, path: /__test/reset }
  create_order:
    method: POST
    path: /orders
    body: "{{args}}"
    capture: { order_id: "$.id" }
  pay_order:
    method: POST
    path: "/orders/{{ctx.order_id}}/pay"
    capture: { first_paid_at: "$.paid_at" }
  mark_shipped: { method: POST, path: "/__test/orders/{{ctx.order_id}}/mark_shipped" }
  mark_delivered: { method: POST, path: "/__test/orders/{{ctx.order_id}}/mark_delivered" }
  cancel_order: { method: POST, path: "/__test/orders/{{ctx.order_id}}/cancel" }
  confirm_delivery: { method: POST, path: "/__test/orders/{{ctx.order_id}}/confirm_delivery" }
queries:
  order: { method: GET, path: "/orders/{{ctx.order_id}}" }

parties.binding_yaml:
doubleblind_binding: "1.0"
side: provider
base_url: "${PROVIDER_BASE_URL}"
app:
  manage: true
  start: "npm start"
  cwd: "."
  env:
    PORT: "${PROVIDER_PORT}"
    SANDBOX: "1"
    PARTNER_API_KEY: "{{secrets.partner_api_key}}"
    WEBHOOK_SECRET: "{{secrets.webhook_secret}}"
  healthcheck:
    method: GET
    path: /health
actions:
  reset:
    method: POST
    path: /__sandbox/reset
  create_partner:
    method: POST
    path: /__sandbox/partners
    body: "{{args}}"
    capture: { partner_id: "$.partner_id", api_key: "$.api_key" }
  advance_shipment:
    method: POST
    path: "/__sandbox/shipments/{{args.shipment_id}}/advance"
    body: { to: "{{args.to}}" }
  advance_shipment_by_reference:
    method: POST
    path: "/__sandbox/shipments/by-reference/{{args.reference}}/advance"
    body: { to: "{{args.to}}" }
  register_webhook:
    method: POST
    path: /v1/webhooks
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer {{ctx.api_key}}"
    body:
      url: "{{args.url}}"
      secret: "{{secrets.webhook_secret}}"

id: spokes-parcelly-shipping
version: 2

parties:

secrets:

schemas:
  Address:
    type: object
    required:
    - street
    - building
    - postcode
    - city
    - country
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      street:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      building:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      flat:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      postcode:
        type: string
        pattern: ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$
      city:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 80
      country:
        const: GB
  Receiver:
    type: object
    required:
    - name
    - phone
    - address
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      name:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      phone:
        type: string
        pattern: ^\+447\d{9}$
      address:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Address'
  CreateShipmentRequest:
    type: object
    required:
    - reference
    - receiver
    - parcel
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      reference:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g
        - size
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
  CreatePalletRequest:
    type: object
    required:
    - reference
    - receiver
    - pallet
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      reference:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      pallet:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g
        - pallet_type
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          pallet_type:
            const: EUR
  ShipmentStatus:
    enum:
    - CREATED
    - COLLECTED
    - IN_TRANSIT
    - DELIVERED
    - RETURNED
  Shipment:
    type: object
    required:
    - id
    - service
    - reference
    - status
    - tracking_number
    - price_pence
    - receiver
    - created_at
    - updated_at
    properties:
      id:
        type: string
      service:
        enum:
        - parcel
        - pallet
      reference:
        type: string
      status:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatus'
      tracking_number:
        type: string
      price_pence:
        type: integer
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
      pallet:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
          pallet_type:
            const: EUR
      created_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
      updated_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time

    type: object
    required:

    properties:
      url:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 2000
      secret:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 256
  WebhookEndpoint:
    type: object
    required:
    - url
    - events
    properties:
      url:
        type: string
      events:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
  ShipmentStatusChanged:
    type: object
    required:
    - event
    - shipment_id
    - reference
    - status
    - occurred_at
    properties:
      event:
        const: shipment.status_changed
      shipment_id:
        type: string
      reference:
        type: string
      status:

      occurred_at:

        format: date-time

    required:
    - code
    - message
    properties:
      code:
        type: string
      message:
        type: string

    request:

          pattern: ^Bearer .+$

      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '422':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'

      default_status: 201
      body:

        service: parcel

        status: CREATED

    responses:

      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '404':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'

      default_status: 200
      body:

        price_pence: 1299

        parcel:
          weight_g: 1200
          size: A
        created_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
        updated_at: '2026-10-06T11:00:00.000Z'
  get_shipment:
    description: One shipment
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: GET
      path: /v1/shipments/{id}
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
    responses:
      '200':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Shipment'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '404':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 200
      body:
        id: shp_1
        service: parcel
        reference: ORD-1001
        status: DELIVERED
        tracking_number: PCL1GB
        price_pence: 1299
        receiver:
          name: John Smith
          phone: '+447700900200'
          address:
            street: Long Street
            building: '5'
            postcode: E1 6AN
            city: London
            country: GB
        parcel:
          weight_g: 1200
          size: A
        created_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
        updated_at: '2026-10-06T12:00:00.000Z'
  create_pallet:
    description: Create a pallet shipment
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: POST
      path: /v1/pallets
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
        Idempotency-Key:
          required: false
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/CreatePalletRequest'
    responses:
      '201':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Shipment'
      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '422':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 201
      body:
        id: plt_1
        service: pallet
        reference: ORD-1002
        status: CREATED
        tracking_number: PAL1GB
        price_pence: 8900

    request:

      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/WebhookRegistration'
    responses:
      '201':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/WebhookEndpoint'
      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 201
      body:
        url: https://shop.example.com/parcelly/webhook
        events:
        - shipment.status_changed

  shipment_status_changed:
    description: Sent when a shipment moves to a different status

    request:

      url: ${CONSUMER_WEBHOOK_URL}

          pattern: ^sha256=[0-9a-f]{64}$

decisions:
- id: D1
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight_g: A (1-5000g), B (5001-15000g), C (15001-25000g). Mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider

  text: Pallet weight_g must be 25001-1000000g. Outside range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider

  text: Postcode area (first 1-2 letters) must match receiver.address.city. Mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
- id: D4

  owner: provider
- id: D5
  text: Webhook shipment.status_changed is emitted only on genuine status transitions (CREATED→COLLECTED, COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED, IN_TRANSIT→RETURNED). Creating a shipment (status CREATED) does NOT emit a webhook. Re-setting the same status does NOT emit a webhook.
  owner: provider
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price is returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
- id: D11
  text: Webhook signatures use HMAC-SHA256 over raw body, header X-Parcelly-Signature, format sha256={hex}. Consumer must verify using webhook_secret. Invalid signature → consumer returns 401.
  owner: provider
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.

  text: Idempotency-Key longer than 255 characters returns 400 INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. Blank or missing key creates a new shipment each time.

- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.

  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.

  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider

  owner: provider

  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider

decisions:
- id: D1
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight_g: A (1-5000g), B (5001-15000g), C (15001-25000g). Mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight_g must be 25001-1000000g. Outside range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
- id: D3
  text: Postcode area (first 1-2 letters) must match receiver.address.city. Mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
- id: D4
  text: Idempotency-Key longer than 255 characters returns 400 INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. Blank or missing key creates a new shipment each time.
  owner: provider
- id: D5
  text: Webhook shipment.status_changed is emitted only on genuine status transitions (CREATED→COLLECTED, COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED, IN_TRANSIT→RETURNED). Creating a shipment (status CREATED) does NOT emit a webhook. Re-setting the same status does NOT emit a webhook.
  owner: provider
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price is returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
- id: D11
  text: Webhook signatures use HMAC-SHA256 over raw body, header X-Parcelly-Signature, format sha256={hex}. Consumer must verify using webhook_secret. Invalid signature → consumer returns 401.
  owner: provider
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): should we use Parcelly's pallet endpoint, or exclude these orders from automated shipping and handle manually? Answer: Use pallet endpoint for >25kg orders"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q1
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): should shipment creation fail fast with validation error, or queue for manual review by warehouse team? Answer: Fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q2

decisions:
- id: D1
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight_g: A (1-5000g), B (5001-15000g), C (15001-25000g). Mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight_g must be 25001-1000000g. Outside range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
- id: D3
  text: Postcode area (first 1-2 letters) must match receiver.address.city. Mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
- id: D4
  text: Idempotency-Key longer than 255 characters returns 400 INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. Blank or missing key creates a new shipment each time.
  owner: provider
- id: D5
  text: Webhook shipment.status_changed is emitted only on genuine status transitions (CREATED→COLLECTED, COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED, IN_TRANSIT→RETURNED). Creating a shipment (status CREATED) does NOT emit a webhook. Re-setting the same status does NOT emit a webhook.
  owner: provider
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price is returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
- id: D11
  text: Webhook signatures use HMAC-SHA256 over raw body, header X-Parcelly-Signature, format sha256={hex}. Consumer must verify using webhook_secret. Invalid signature → consumer returns 401.
  owner: provider
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): should we use Parcelly's pallet endpoint, or exclude these orders from automated shipping and handle manually? Answer: Use pallet endpoint for >25kg orders"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q1
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): should shipment creation fail fast with validation error, or queue for manual review by warehouse team? Answer: Fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q2

  text: Pallet weight_g must be 25001-1000000g. Outside range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
- id: D3
  text: Postcode area (first 1-2 letters) must match receiver.address.city. Mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
- id: D4
  text: Idempotency-Key longer than 255 characters returns 400 INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. Blank or missing key creates a new shipment each time.
  owner: provider
- id: D5
  text: Webhook shipment.status_changed is emitted only on genuine status transitions (CREATED→COLLECTED, COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED, IN_TRANSIT→RETURNED). Creating a shipment (status CREATED) does NOT emit a webhook. Re-setting the same status does NOT emit a webhook.
  owner: provider
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price is returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
- id: D11
  text: Webhook signatures use HMAC-SHA256 over raw body, header X-Parcelly-Signature, format sha256={hex}. Consumer must verify using webhook_secret. Invalid signature → consumer returns 401.
  owner: provider
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): should we use Parcelly's pallet endpoint, or exclude these orders from automated shipping and handle manually? Answer: Use pallet endpoint for >25kg orders"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q1
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): should shipment creation fail fast with validation error, or queue for manual review by warehouse team? Answer: Fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q2
- id: D14
  text: Spokes stores UK phone numbers in free-text format. Parcelly requires E.164 +447XXXXXXXXX. Consumer normalizes by stripping non-digits, ensuring leading +447, and validating 11 digits after +44.
  owner: consumer
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes stores address as single free-text line. Parcelly requires structured fields: street, building, postcode, city, country=GB. Consumer extracts postcode (UK format, last token), city (token before postcode), street+building from remainder. If postcode/city cannot be extracted, fail fast.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D16
  text: 'Spokes stores weight_kg as float. Parcelly requires weight_g integer (grams). Consumer converts: weight_g = round(weight_kg * 1000). Parcel threshold: weight_g ≤ 25000 → parcel (size A/B/C by weight tier); weight_g > 25000 → pallet endpoint. Cargo bikes >25kg use pallet endpoint.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D17
  text: 'Parcel size tier derived from weight_g: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001-15000g, C 15001-25000g. Consumer selects size field accordingly.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D18
  text: Spokes uses handler-based idempotency. Parcelly uses Idempotency-Key header (≤255 chars, scoped per partner). Consumer sends Spokes order reference as Idempotency-Key on shipment creation.
  owner: consumer
- id: D19
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D20
  text: For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode), shipment creation fails fast with validation error returned to order paid handler.
  owner: consumer
- id: D21
  text: For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg), consumer uses Parcelly's pallet endpoint.
  owner: consumer

  - send:

id: spokes-parcelly-shipping

schemas:

        maxLength: 20

        type: string
        pattern: ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$

        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 80
      country:
        const: GB
  Receiver:
    type: object
    required:

    - phone
    - address
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:

        maxLength: 120

  CreateShipmentRequest:

    required:

    enum:

    - RETURNED

    type: object

    - id
    - service
    - reference
    - status

    - price_pence
    - receiver

    - updated_at
    properties:
      id:
        type: string
      service:
        enum:
        - parcel
        - pallet
      reference:
        type: string
      status:

      tracking_number:
        type: string
      price_pence:
        type: integer
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
      pallet:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer

      created_at:

  owner: provider
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
- id: D11
  text: Webhook signatures use HMAC-SHA256 over raw body, header X-Parcelly-Signature, format sha256={hex}. Consumer must verify using webhook_secret. Invalid signature → consumer returns 401.
  owner: provider
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): should we use Parcelly's pallet endpoint, or exclude these orders from automated shipping and handle manually? Answer: Use pallet endpoint for >25kg orders"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q1
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): should shipment creation fail fast with validation error, or queue for manual review by warehouse team? Answer: Fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q2
- id: D14
  text: Spokes stores UK phone numbers in free-text format. Parcelly requires E.164 +447XXXXXXXXX. Consumer normalizes by stripping non-digits, ensuring leading +447, and validating 11 digits after +44.
  owner: consumer
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes stores address as single free-text line. Parcelly requires structured fields: street, building, postcode, city, country=GB. Consumer extracts postcode (UK format, last token), city (token before postcode), street+building from remainder. If postcode/city cannot be extracted, fail fast.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D16
  text: 'Spokes stores weight_kg as float. Parcelly requires weight_g integer (grams). Consumer converts: weight_g = round(weight_kg * 1000). Parcel threshold: weight_g ≤ 25000 → parcel (size A/B/C by weight tier); weight_g > 25000 → pallet endpoint. Cargo bikes >25kg use pallet endpoint.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D17
  text: 'Parcel size tier derived from weight_g: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001-15000g, C 15001-25000g. Consumer selects size field accordingly.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D18
  text: Spokes uses handler-based idempotency. Parcelly uses Idempotency-Key header (≤255 chars, scoped per partner). Consumer sends Spokes order reference as Idempotency-Key on shipment creation.
  owner: consumer
- id: D19
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D20
  text: For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode), shipment creation fails fast with validation error returned to order paid handler.
  owner: consumer
- id: D21
  text: For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg), consumer uses Parcelly's pallet endpoint.
  owner: consumer
- id: H3
  text: 'For orders with multiple items shipping to different addresses (split shipments): should Spokes create one Parcelly shipment per address, or is this not supported in current order model? Answer: Not supported - single address per order'
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q3

decisions:
- id: D1
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight_g: A (1-5000g), B (5001-15000g), C (15001-25000g). Mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight_g must be 25001-1000000g. Outside range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
- id: D3
  text: Postcode area (first 1-2 letters) must match receiver.address.city. Mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
- id: D4
  text: Idempotency-Key longer than 255 characters returns 400 INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. Blank or missing key creates a new shipment each time.
  owner: provider
- id: D5
  text: Webhook shipment.status_changed is emitted only on genuine status transitions (CREATED→COLLECTED, COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED, IN_TRANSIT→RETURNED). Creating a shipment (status CREATED) does NOT emit a webhook. Re-setting the same status does NOT emit a webhook.
  owner: provider
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price is returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
- id: D11
  text: Webhook signatures use HMAC-SHA256 over raw body, header X-Parcelly-Signature, format sha256={hex}. Consumer must verify using webhook_secret. Invalid signature → consumer returns 401.
  owner: provider
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): should we use Parcelly's pallet endpoint, or exclude these orders from automated shipping and handle manually? Answer: Use pallet endpoint for >25kg orders"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q1
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): should shipment creation fail fast with validation error, or queue for manual review by warehouse team? Answer: Fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)"

  origin_question: Q2
- id: D14
  text: Spokes stores UK phone numbers in free-text format. Parcelly requires E.164 +447XXXXXXXXX. Consumer normalizes by stripping non-digits, ensuring leading +447, and validating 11 digits after +44.
  owner: consumer
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes stores address as single free-text line. Parcelly requires structured fields: street, building, postcode, city, country=GB. Consumer extracts postcode (UK format, last token), city (token before postcode), street+building from remainder. If postcode/city cannot be extracted, fail fast.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D16
  text: 'Spokes stores weight_kg as float. Parcelly requires weight_g integer (grams). Consumer converts: weight_g = round(weight_kg * 1000). Parcel threshold: weight_g ≤ 25000 → parcel (size A/B/C by weight tier); weight_g > 25000 → pallet endpoint. Cargo bikes >25kg use pallet endpoint.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D17
  text: 'Parcel size tier derived from weight_g: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001-15000g, C 15001-25000g. Consumer selects size field accordingly.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D18
  text: Spokes uses handler-based idempotency. Parcelly uses Idempotency-Key header (≤255 chars, scoped per partner). Consumer sends Spokes order reference as Idempotency-Key on shipment creation.
  owner: consumer
- id: D19
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D20
  text: For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode), shipment creation fails fast with validation error returned to order paid handler.
  owner: consumer
- id: D21
  text: For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg), consumer uses Parcelly's pallet endpoint.
  owner: consumer
- id: H3
  text: 'For orders with multiple items shipping to different addresses (split shipments): should Spokes create one Parcelly shipment per address, or is this not supported in current order model? Answer: Not supported - single address per order'
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q3
- id: H4
  text: "When Parcelly webhook delivers 'delivered' status, should Spokes automatically mark order as 'delivered', or does warehouse team still manually confirm? Answer: Warehouse manually confirms"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q4

decisions:
- id: D1
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight_g: A (1-5000g), B (5001-15000g), C (15001-25000g). Mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight_g must be 25001-1000000g. Outside range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
- id: D3
  text: Postcode area (first 1-2 letters) must match receiver.address.city. Mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
- id: D4
  text: Idempotency-Key longer than 255 characters returns 400 INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. Blank or missing key creates a new shipment each time.
  owner: provider
- id: D5
  text: Webhook shipment.status_changed is emitted only on genuine status transitions (CREATED→COLLECTED, COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED, IN_TRANSIT→RETURNED). Creating a shipment (status CREATED) does NOT emit a webhook. Re-setting the same status does NOT emit a webhook.
  owner: provider
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price is returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
- id: D11
  text: Webhook signatures use HMAC-SHA256 over raw body, header X-Parcelly-Signature, format sha256={hex}. Consumer must verify using webhook_secret. Invalid signature → consumer returns 401.
  owner: provider
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): should we use Parcelly's pallet endpoint, or exclude these orders from automated shipping and handle manually? Answer: Use pallet endpoint for >25kg orders"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q1
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): should shipment creation fail fast with validation error, or queue for manual review by warehouse team? Answer: Fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q2
- id: D14
  text: Spokes stores UK phone numbers in free-text format. Parcelly requires E.164 +447XXXXXXXXX. Consumer normalizes by stripping non-digits, ensuring leading +447, and validating 11 digits after +44.
  owner: consumer
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes stores address as single free-text line. Parcelly requires structured fields: street, building, postcode, city, country=GB. Consumer extracts postcode (UK format, last token), city (token before postcode), street+building from remainder. If postcode/city cannot be extracted, fail fast.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D16
  text: 'Spokes stores weight_kg as float. Parcelly requires weight_g integer (grams). Consumer converts: weight_g = round(weight_kg * 1000). Parcel threshold: weight_g ≤ 25000 → parcel (size A/B/C by weight tier); weight_g > 25000 → pallet endpoint. Cargo bikes >25kg use pallet endpoint.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D17
  text: 'Parcel size tier derived from weight_g: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001-15000g, C 15001-25000g. Consumer selects size field accordingly.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D18
  text: Spokes uses handler-based idempotency. Parcelly uses Idempotency-Key header (≤255 chars, scoped per partner). Consumer sends Spokes order reference as Idempotency-Key on shipment creation.
  owner: consumer
- id: D19
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D20
  text: For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode), shipment creation fails fast with validation error returned to order paid handler.
  owner: consumer
- id: D21
  text: For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg), consumer uses Parcelly's pallet endpoint.
  owner: consumer
- id: H3
  text: 'For orders with multiple items shipping to different addresses (split shipments): should Spokes create one Parcelly shipment per address, or is this not supported in current order model? Answer: Not supported - single address per order'
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q3
- id: H4
  text: "When Parcelly webhook delivers 'delivered' status, should Spokes automatically mark order as 'delivered', or does warehouse team still manually confirm? Answer: Warehouse manually confirms"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q4

doubleblind: '1.0'
id: spokes-parcelly-shipping
version: 10
status: proposed
parties:
  consumer:
    id: spokes
    name: Spokes (bike shop)
  provider:
    id: parcelly
    name: Parcelly (courier)
environments: {}
secrets:
- name: partner_api_key
  description: Partner API key issued by Parcelly
- name: webhook_secret
  description: Secret for webhook signatures
glossary: {}
schemas:
  Address:
    type: object
    required:
    - street
    - building
    - postcode
    - city
    - country
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      street:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      building:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      flat:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      postcode:
        type: string
        pattern: ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$
      city:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 80
      country:
        const: GB
  Receiver:
    type: object
    required:
    - name
    - phone
    - address
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      name:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      phone:
        type: string
        pattern: ^\+447\d{9}$
      address:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Address'
  CreateShipmentRequest:
    type: object
    required:
    - reference
    - receiver
    - parcel
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      reference:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g
        - size
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
  CreatePalletRequest:
    type: object
    required:
    - reference
    - receiver
    - pallet
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      reference:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      pallet:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g
        - pallet_type
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          pallet_type:
            const: EUR
  ShipmentStatus:
    enum:
    - CREATED
    - COLLECTED
    - IN_TRANSIT
    - DELIVERED
    - RETURNED
  Shipment:
    type: object
    required:
    - id
    - service
    - reference
    - status
    - tracking_number
    - price_pence
    - receiver
    - created_at
    - updated_at
    properties:
      id:
        type: string
      service:
        enum:
        - parcel
        - pallet
      reference:
        type: string
      status:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatus'
      tracking_number:
        type: string
      price_pence:
        type: integer
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
      pallet:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
          pallet_type:
            const: EUR
      created_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
      updated_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
  WebhookRegistration:
    type: object
    required:
    - url
    - secret
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      url:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 2000
      secret:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 256
  WebhookEndpoint:
    type: object
    required:
    - url
    - events
    properties:
      url:
        type: string
      events:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
  ShipmentStatusChanged:
    type: object
    required:
    - event
    - shipment_id
    - reference
    - status
    - occurred_at
    properties:
      event:
        const: shipment.status_changed
      shipment_id:
        type: string
      reference:
        type: string
      status:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatus'
      occurred_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
  Error:
    type: object
    required:
    - code
    - message
    properties:
      code:
        type: string
      message:
        type: string
operations:
  create_shipment:
    description: Create a parcel shipment
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: POST
      path: /v1/shipments
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
        Idempotency-Key:
          required: false
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/CreateShipmentRequest'
    responses:
      '201':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Shipment'
      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '422':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 201
      body:
        id: shp_1
        service: parcel
        reference: ORD-1001
        status: CREATED
        tracking_number: PCL1GB
        price_pence: 1299
        receiver:

    request:

    responses:
      '200':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Shipment'
      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '404':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 200
      body:
        id: shp_1
        service: parcel
        reference: ORD-1001
        status: IN_TRANSIT
        tracking_number: PCL1GB
        price_pence: 1299
        receiver:
          name: John Smith
          phone: '+447700900200'
          address:
            street: Long Street
            building: '5'
            postcode: E1 6AN
            city: London
            country: GB
        parcel:
          weight_g: 1200
          size: A
        created_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
        updated_at: '2026-10-06T11:00:00.000Z'
  get_shipment:
    description: One shipment
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: GET
      path: /v1/shipments/{id}
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
    responses:
      '200':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Shipment'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '404':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 200
      body:
        id: shp_1
        service: parcel
        reference: ORD-1001
        status: DELIVERED
        tracking_number: PCL1GB
        price_pence: 1299
        receiver:
          name: John Smith
          phone: '+447700900200'
          address:
            street: Long Street
            building: '5'
            postcode: E1 6AN
            city: London
            country: GB
        parcel:
          weight_g: 1200
          size: A
        created_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
        updated_at: '2026-10-06T12:00:00.000Z'
  create_pallet:
    description: Create a pallet shipment
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: POST
      path: /v1/pallets
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
        Idempotency-Key:
          required: false
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/CreatePalletRequest'
    responses:
      '201':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Shipment'
      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '422':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 201
      body:
        id: plt_1
        service: pallet
        reference: ORD-1002
        status: CREATED
        tracking_number: PAL1GB
        price_pence: 8900
        receiver:
          name: Emma Brown
          phone: '+447700900300'
          address:
            street: Corn Street
            building: '1'
            postcode: BS1 1HQ
            city: Bristol
            country: GB
        pallet:
          weight_g: 27000
          pallet_type: EUR
        created_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
        updated_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
      idempotent_on_header: Idempotency-Key
  register_webhook:
    description: Register or replace the partner's webhook endpoint
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: POST
      path: /v1/webhooks
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/WebhookRegistration'
    responses:
      '201':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/WebhookEndpoint'
      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 201
      body:
        url: https://shop.example.com/parcelly/webhook
        events:
        - shipment.status_changed
webhooks:
  shipment_status_changed:
    description: Sent when a shipment moves to a different status
    direction: provider_to_consumer
    request:
      method: POST
      url: ${CONSUMER_WEBHOOK_URL}
      headers:
        X-Parcelly-Signature:
          required: true
          pattern: ^sha256=[0-9a-f]{64}$
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatusChanged'
    signature:
      algorithm: hmac-sha256
      header: X-Parcelly-Signature
      format: sha256={hex}
      over: raw_body
      secret: webhook_secret
semantic_mappings:
  spokes_order_status_to_shipment_status:
    paid: CREATED
    shipped: COLLECTED
    delivered: DELIVERED
    cancelled: RETURNED
  shipment_status_to_spokes_order_status:
    CREATED: paid
    COLLECTED: shipped
    IN_TRANSIT: shipped
    DELIVERED: delivered
    RETURNED: cancelled
decisions:
- id: D1
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight_g: A (1-5000g), B (5001-15000g), C (15001-25000g). Mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight_g must be 25001-1000000g. Outside range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
- id: D3
  text: Postcode area (first 1-2 letters) must match receiver.address.city. Mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
- id: D4
  text: Idempotency-Key longer than 255 characters returns 400 INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. Blank or missing key creates a new shipment each time.
  owner: provider
- id: D5
  text: Webhook shipment.status_changed emitted only on genuine status transitions (CREATED→COLLECTED, COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED, IN_TRANSIT→RETURNED). Creating a shipment (status CREATED) does NOT emit a webhook. Re-setting the same status does NOT emit a webhook.
  owner: provider
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
- id: D11
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: provider
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): should we use Parcelly's pallet endpoint, or exclude these orders from automated shipping and handle manually? Answer: Use pallet endpoint for >25kg orders"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q1
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): should shipment creation fail fast with validation error, or queue for manual review by warehouse team? Answer: Fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q2
- id: D14
  text: Spokes stores UK phone numbers in free-text format. Parcelly requires E.164 +447XXXXXXXXX. Consumer normalizes by stripping non-digits, ensuring leading +447, and validating 11 digits after +44.
  owner: consumer
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes stores address as single free-text line. Parcelly requires structured fields: street, building, postcode, city, country=GB. Consumer extracts postcode (UK format, last token), city (token before postcode), street+building from remainder. If postcode/city cannot be extracted, fail fast.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D16
  text: 'Spokes stores weight_kg as float. Parcelly requires weight_g integer (grams). Consumer converts: weight_g = round(weight_kg * 1000). Parcel threshold: weight_g ≤ 25000 → parcel (size A/B/C by weight tier); weight_g > 25000 → pallet endpoint. Cargo bikes >25kg use pallet endpoint.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D17
  text: 'Parcel size tier derived from weight_g: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001-15000g, C 15001-25000g. Consumer selects size field accordingly.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D18
  text: Spokes uses handler-based idempotency. Parcelly uses Idempotency-Key header (≤255 chars, scoped per partner). Consumer sends Spokes order reference as Idempotency-Key on shipment creation.
  owner: consumer
- id: D19
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D20
  text: For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode), shipment creation fails fast with validation error returned to order paid handler.
  owner: consumer
- id: D21
  text: For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg), consumer uses Parcelly's pallet endpoint.
  owner: consumer
- id: H3
  text: 'For orders with multiple items shipping to different addresses (split shipments): should Spokes create one Parcelly shipment per address, or is this not supported in current order model? Answer: Not supported - single address per order'
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q3
- id: H4
  text: "When Parcelly webhook delivers 'delivered' status, should Spokes automatically mark order as 'delivered', or does warehouse team still manually confirm? Answer: Warehouse manually confirms"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q4
- id: D22
  text: 'Order paid event handlers (ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS) must be idempotent: payment gateway may retry confirmations (second call finds order already paid, keeps original paid_at, calls handlers again). Exception in a handler is logged and does not undo payment; remaining handlers still run.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D23
  text: When order status changes from pending to paid, Spokes creates a Parcelly shipment (parcel or pallet based on weight_g). This happens in an ORDER_PAID_HANDLER and must be idempotent (uses order reference as Idempotency-Key).
  owner: consumer
- id: D24
  text: 'Spokes order status lifecycle: pending → paid → shipped → delivered, with cancelled as a branch from pending via support. No automated carrier status; shipped and delivered set manually by warehouse team.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D25
  text: POST /orders/{id}/pay returns 409 ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE if order status not in (pending, paid). Duplicate payment confirmation does not change paid_at; original timestamp preserved.
  owner: consumer

  provider: []
  consumer: []

  - send:

doubleblind: '1.0'
id: spokes-parcelly-shipping
version: 11
status: proposed
parties:
  consumer:
    id: spokes
    name: Spokes (bike shop)
  provider:
    id: parcelly
    name: Parcelly (courier)
environments: {}
secrets:
- name: partner_api_key
  description: Partner API key issued by Parcelly
- name: webhook_secret
  description: Secret for webhook signatures
glossary: {}
schemas:
  Address:
    type: object
    required:
    - street
    - building
    - postcode
    - city
    - country
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      street:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      building:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      flat:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      postcode:
        type: string
        pattern: ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$
      city:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 80
      country:
        const: GB
  Receiver:
    type: object
    required:
    - name
    - phone
    - address
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      name:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      phone:
        type: string
        pattern: ^\+447\d{9}$
      address:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Address'
  CreateShipmentRequest:
    type: object
    required:
    - reference
    - receiver
    - parcel
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      reference:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g
        - size
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
  CreatePalletRequest:
    type: object
    required:
    - reference
    - receiver
    - pallet
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      reference:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      pallet:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g
        - pallet_type
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          pallet_type:
            const: EUR
  ShipmentStatus:
    enum:
    - CREATED
    - COLLECTED
    - IN_TRANSIT
    - DELIVERED
    - RETURNED
  Shipment:
    type: object
    required:
    - id
    - service
    - reference
    - status
    - tracking_number
    - price_pence
    - receiver
    - created_at
    - updated_at
    properties:
      id:
        type: string
      service:
        enum:
        - parcel
        - pallet
      reference:
        type: string
      status:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatus'
      tracking_number:
        type: string
      price_pence:
        type: integer
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
      pallet:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
          pallet_type:
            const: EUR
      created_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
      updated_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
  WebhookRegistration:
    type: object
    required:
    - url
    - secret
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      url:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 2000
      secret:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 256
  WebhookEndpoint:
    type: object
    required:
    - url
    - events
    properties:
      url:
        type: string
      events:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
  ShipmentStatusChanged:
    type: object
    required:
    - event
    - shipment_id
    - reference
    - status
    - occurred_at
    properties:
      event:
        const: shipment.status_changed
      shipment_id:
        type: string
      reference:
        type: string
      status:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatus'
      occurred_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
  Error:
    type: object
    required:
    - code
    - message
    properties:
      code:
        type: string
      message:
        type: string
operations:
  create_shipment:
    description: Create a parcel shipment
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: POST
      path: /v1/shipments
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
        Idempotency-Key:
          required: false
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/CreateShipmentRequest'
    responses:
      '201':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Shipment'
      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '422':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 201
      body:
        id: shp_1
        service: parcel
        reference: ORD-1001
        status: CREATED
        tracking_number: PCL1GB
        price_pence: 1299
        receiver:

            city: London
            country: GB
        parcel:

decisions:
- id: D1
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight_g: A (1-5000g), B (5001-15000g), C (15001-25000g). Mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight_g must be 25001-1000000g. Outside range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
- id: D3
  text: Postcode area (first 1-2 letters) must match receiver.address.city. Mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
- id: D4
  text: Idempotency-Key longer than 255 characters returns 400 INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. Blank or missing key creates a new shipment each time.
  owner: provider
- id: D5
  text: Webhook shipment.status_changed emitted only on genuine status transitions (CREATED→COLLECTED, COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED, IN_TRANSIT→RETURNED). Creating a shipment (status CREATED) does NOT emit a webhook. Re-setting the same status does NOT emit a webhook.
  owner: provider
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
- id: D11
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: provider
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): should we use Parcelly's pallet endpoint, or exclude these orders from automated shipping and handle manually? Answer: Use pallet endpoint for >25kg orders"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q1
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): should shipment creation fail fast with validation error, or queue for manual review by warehouse team? Answer: Fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q2
- id: D14
  text: Spokes stores UK phone numbers in free-text format. Parcelly requires E.164 +447XXXXXXXXX. Consumer normalizes by stripping non-digits, ensuring leading +447, and validating 11 digits after +44.
  owner: consumer
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes stores address as single free-text line. Parcelly requires structured fields: street, building, postcode, city, country=GB. Consumer extracts postcode (UK format, last token), city (token before postcode), street+building from remainder. If postcode/city cannot be extracted, fail fast.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D16
  text: 'Spokes stores weight_kg as float. Parcelly requires weight_g integer (grams). Consumer converts: weight_g = round(weight_kg * 1000). Parcel threshold: weight_g ≤ 25000 → parcel (size A/B/C by weight tier); weight_g > 25000 → pallet endpoint. Cargo bikes >25kg use pallet endpoint.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D17
  text: 'Parcel size tier derived from weight_g: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001-15000g, C 15001-25000g. Consumer selects size field accordingly.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D18
  text: Spokes uses handler-based idempotency. Parcelly uses Idempotency-Key header (≤255 chars, scoped per partner). Consumer sends Spokes order reference as Idempotency-Key on shipment creation.
  owner: consumer
- id: D19
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D20
  text: For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode), shipment creation fails fast with validation error returned to order paid handler.
  owner: consumer
- id: D21
  text: For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg), consumer uses Parcelly's pallet endpoint.
  owner: consumer
- id: H3
  text: 'For orders with multiple items shipping to different addresses (split shipments): should Spokes create one Parcelly shipment per address, or is this not supported in current order model? Answer: Not supported - single address per order'
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q3
- id: H4
  text: "When Parcelly webhook delivers 'delivered' status, should Spokes automatically mark order as 'delivered', or does warehouse team still manually confirm? Answer: Warehouse manually confirms"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q4
- id: D22
  text: 'Order paid event handlers (ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS) must be idempotent: payment gateway may retry confirmations (second call finds order already paid, keeps original paid_at, calls handlers again). Exception in a handler is logged and does not undo payment; remaining handlers still run.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D23
  text: When order status changes from pending to paid, Spokes creates a Parcelly shipment (parcel or pallet based on weight_g). This happens in an ORDER_PAID_HANDLER and must be idempotent (uses order reference as Idempotency-Key).
  owner: consumer
- id: D24
  text: 'Spokes order status lifecycle: pending → paid → shipped → delivered, with cancelled as a branch from pending via support. No automated carrier status; shipped and delivered set manually by warehouse team.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D25
  text: POST /orders/{id}/pay returns 409 ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE if order status not in (pending, paid). Duplicate payment confirmation does not change paid_at; original timestamp preserved.
  owner: consumer
- id: H5
  text: 'For orders with multiple items shipping to different addresses (split shipments): should Spokes create one Parcelly shipment per address, or is this not supported in current order model? Answer: Not supported - single address per order'
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q5

webhooks:
  shipment_status_changed:
    description: Sent when a shipment moves to a different status
    direction: provider_to_consumer
    request:
      method: POST
      url: ${CONSUMER_WEBHOOK_URL}
      headers:
        X-Parcelly-Signature:
          required: true
          pattern: ^sha256=[0-9a-f]{64}$
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatusChanged'
    signature:
      algorithm: hmac-sha256
      header: X-Parcelly-Signature
      format: sha256={hex}
      over: raw_body
      secret: webhook_secret

decisions:
- id: D1
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight_g: A (1-5000g), B (5001-15000g), C (15001-25000g). Mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight_g must be 25001-1000000g. Outside range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
- id: D3
  text: Postcode area (first 1-2 letters) must match receiver.address.city. Mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
- id: D4
  text: Idempotency-Key longer than 255 characters returns 400 INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. Blank or missing key creates a new shipment each time.
  owner: provider
- id: D5
  text: Webhook shipment.status_changed emitted only on genuine status transitions (CREATED→COLLECTED, COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED, IN_TRANSIT→RETURNED). Creating a shipment (status CREATED) does NOT emit a webhook. Re-setting the same status does NOT emit a webhook.
  owner: provider
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
- id: D11
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: provider
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): should we use Parcelly's pallet endpoint, or exclude these orders from automated shipping and handle manually? Answer: Use pallet endpoint for >25kg orders"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q1
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): should shipment creation fail fast with validation error, or queue for manual review by warehouse team? Answer: Fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q2
- id: D14
  text: Spokes stores UK phone numbers in free-text format. Parcelly requires E.164 +447XXXXXXXXX. Consumer normalizes by stripping non-digits, ensuring leading +447, and validating 11 digits after +44.
  owner: consumer
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes stores address as single free-text line. Parcelly requires structured fields: street, building, postcode, city, country=GB. Consumer extracts postcode (UK format, last token), city (token before postcode), street+building from remainder. If postcode/city cannot be extracted, fail fast.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D16
  text: 'Spokes stores weight_kg as float. Parcelly requires weight_g integer (grams). Consumer converts: weight_g = round(weight_kg * 1000). Parcel threshold: weight_g ≤ 25000 → parcel (size A/B/C by weight tier); weight_g > 25000 → pallet endpoint. Cargo bikes >25kg use pallet endpoint.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D17
  text: 'Parcel size tier derived from weight_g: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001-15000g, C 15001-25000g. Consumer selects size field accordingly.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D18
  text: Spokes uses handler-based idempotency. Parcelly uses Idempotency-Key header (≤255 chars, scoped per partner). Consumer sends Spokes order reference as Idempotency-Key on shipment creation.
  owner: consumer
- id: D19
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D20
  text: For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode), shipment creation fails fast with validation error returned to order paid handler.
  owner: consumer
- id: D21
  text: For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg), consumer uses Parcelly's pallet endpoint.
  owner: consumer
- id: H3
  text: 'For orders with multiple items shipping to different addresses (split shipments): should Spokes create one Parcelly shipment per address, or is this not supported in current order model? Answer: Not supported - single address per order'
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q3
- id: H4
  text: "When Parcelly webhook delivers 'delivered' status, should Spokes automatically mark order as 'delivered', or does warehouse team still manually confirm? Answer: Warehouse manually confirms"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q4
- id: D22
  text: 'Order paid event handlers (ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS) must be idempotent: payment gateway may retry confirmations (second call finds order already paid, keeps original paid_at, calls handlers again). Exception in a handler is logged and does not undo payment; remaining handlers still run.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D23
  text: When order status changes from pending to paid, Spokes creates a Parcelly shipment (parcel or pallet based on weight_g). This happens in an ORDER_PAID_HANDLER and must be idempotent (uses order reference as Idempotency-Key).
  owner: consumer
- id: D24
  text: 'Spokes order status lifecycle: pending → paid → shipped → delivered, with cancelled as a branch from pending via support. No automated carrier status; shipped and delivered set manually by warehouse team.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D25
  text: POST /orders/{id}/pay returns 409 ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE if order status not in (pending, paid). Duplicate payment confirmation does not change paid_at; original timestamp preserved.
  owner: consumer
- id: H5
  text: 'For orders with multiple items shipping to different addresses (split shipments): should Spokes create one Parcelly shipment per address, or is this not supported in current order model? Answer: Not supported - single address per order'
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q5
- id: H6
  text: "When Parcelly webhook delivers 'delivered' status, should Spokes automatically mark order as 'delivered', or does warehouse team still manually confirm? Answer: Warehouse manually confirms"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q6

decisions:
- id: D1
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight_g: A (1-5000g), B (5001-15000g), C (15001-25000g). Mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight_g must be 25001-1000000g. Outside range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
- id: D3
  text: Postcode area (first 1-2 letters) must match receiver.address.city. Mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
- id: D4
  text: Idempotency-Key longer than 255 characters returns 400 INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. Blank or missing key creates a new shipment each time.
  owner: provider
- id: D5
  text: Webhook shipment.status_changed emitted only on genuine status transitions (CREATED→COLLECTED, COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED, IN_TRANSIT→RETURNED). Creating a shipment (status CREATED) does NOT emit a webhook. Re-setting the same status does NOT emit a webhook.
  owner: provider
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
- id: D11
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: provider
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
- id: D14
  text: Spokes stores UK phone numbers in free-text format. Parcelly requires E.164 +447XXXXXXXXX. Consumer normalizes by stripping non-digits, ensuring leading +447, and validating 11 digits after +44.
  owner: consumer
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes stores address as single free-text line. Parcelly requires structured fields: street, building, postcode, city, country=GB. Consumer extracts postcode (UK format, last token), city (token before postcode), street+building from remainder. If postcode/city cannot be extracted, fail fast.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D16
  text: 'Spokes stores weight_kg as float. Parcelly requires weight_g integer (grams). Consumer converts: weight_g = round(weight_kg * 1000). Parcel threshold: weight_g ≤ 25000 → parcel (size A/B/C by weight tier); weight_g > 25000 → pallet endpoint. Cargo bikes >25kg use pallet endpoint.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D17
  text: 'Parcel size tier derived from weight_g: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001-15000g, C 15001-25000g. Consumer selects size field accordingly.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D18
  text: Spokes uses handler-based idempotency. Parcelly uses Idempotency-Key header (≤255 chars, scoped per partner). Consumer sends Spokes order reference as Idempotency-Key on shipment creation.
  owner: consumer
- id: D19
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D20
  text: 'Order paid event handlers (ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS) must be idempotent: payment gateway may retry confirmations (second call finds order already paid, keeps original paid_at, calls handlers again). Exception in a handler is logged and does not undo payment; remaining handlers still run.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D21
  text: When order status changes from pending to paid, Spokes creates a Parcelly shipment (parcel or pallet based on weight_g). This happens in an ORDER_PAID_HANDLER and must be idempotent (uses order reference as Idempotency-Key).
  owner: consumer
- id: D22
  text: 'Spokes order status lifecycle: pending → paid → shipped → delivered, with cancelled as a branch from pending via support. No automated carrier status; shipped and delivered set manually by warehouse team.'
  owner: consumer
- id: D23
  text: POST /orders/{id}/pay returns 409 ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE if order status not in (pending, paid). Duplicate payment confirmation does not change paid_at; original timestamp preserved.
  owner: consumer
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): should we use Parcelly's pallet endpoint, or exclude these orders from automated shipping and handle manually? Answer: Use pallet endpoint for >25kg orders"
  owner: consumer
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): should shipment creation fail fast with validation error, or queue for manual review by warehouse team? Answer: Fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)"
  owner: consumer
- id: D24
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
- id: D25
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
- id: D26
  text: Pallet type must be EUR. Any other value returns 422 INVALID_PALLET_TYPE.
  owner: provider

id: spokes-parcelly-shipping
version: 14
status: proposed
parties:

    id: spokes
    name: Spokes (bike shop)
  provider:
    id: parcelly
    name: Parcelly (courier)
environments: {}
secrets:
- name: partner_api_key

- name: webhook_secret
  description: Secret for webhook signatures
glossary: {}
schemas:
  Address:
    type: object
    required:
