doubleblind: '1.0'
id: spokes-parcelly-shipping
version: 28
status: proposed
parties:
  consumer:
    id: spokes
    name: Spokes (bike shop)
  provider:
    id: parcelly
    name: Parcelly (courier)
environments: {}
secrets:
- name: partner_api_key
  description: Partner API key issued by Parcelly
- name: webhook_secret
  description: Secret for webhook signatures
glossary:
  mark_shipped: 'Internal consumer action: called by warehouse UI to transition order from paid → shipped. Triggers Parcelly shipment creation if not already created (idempotent via order reference as Idempotency-Key).'
  mark_delivered: 'Internal consumer action: called by warehouse UI to transition order from shipped → delivered. No carrier integration; status set manually.'
  cancel_order: 'Internal consumer action: called by support to transition order from pending → cancelled. Adds note in helpdesk; no automated carrier return status.'
schemas:
  Address:
    type: object
    required:
    - street
    - building
    - postcode
    - city
    - country
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      street:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      building:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      flat:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      postcode:
        type: string
        pattern: ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$
      city:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 80
      country:
        const: GB
  Receiver:
    type: object
    required:
    - name
    - phone
    - address
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      name:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      phone:
        type: string
        pattern: ^\+447\d{9}$
      address:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Address'
  CreateShipmentRequest:
    type: object
    required:
    - reference
    - receiver
    - parcel
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      reference:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g
        - size
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
  CreatePalletRequest:
    type: object
    required:
    - reference
    - receiver
    - pallet
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      reference:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      pallet:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g
        - pallet_type
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          pallet_type:
            const: EUR
  ShipmentStatus:
    enum:
    - CREATED
    - COLLECTED
    - IN_TRANSIT
    - DELIVERED
    - RETURNED
  Shipment:
    type: object
    required:
    - id
    - service
    - reference
    - status
    - tracking_number
    - price_pence
    - receiver
    - created_at
    - updated_at
    properties:
      id:
        type: string
      service:
        enum:
        - parcel
        - pallet
      reference:
        type: string
      status:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatus'
      tracking_number:
        type: string
      price_pence:
        type: integer
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
      pallet:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
          pallet_type:
            const: EUR
      created_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
      updated_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
  WebhookRegistration:
    type: object
    required:
    - url
    - secret
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      url:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 2000
      secret:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 256
  WebhookEndpoint:
    type: object
    required:
    - url
    - events
    properties:
      url:
        type: string
      events:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
  ShipmentStatusChanged:
    type: object
    required:
    - event
    - shipment_id
    - reference
    - status
    - occurred_at
    properties:
      event:
        const: shipment.status_changed
      shipment_id:
        type: string
      reference:
        type: string
      status:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatus'
      occurred_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
  Error:
    type: object
    required:
    - code
    - message
    properties:
      code:
        type: string
      message:
        type: string
operations:
  create_shipment:
    description: Create a parcel shipment
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: POST
      path: /v1/shipments
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
        Idempotency-Key:
          required: false
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/CreateShipmentRequest'
    responses:
      '201':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Shipment'
      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '422':
        body:

webhooks:
  shipment_status_changed:
    description: Sent when a shipment moves to a different status
    direction: provider_to_consumer
    request:
      method: POST
      url: ${CONSUMER_WEBHOOK_URL}
      headers:
        X-Parcelly-Signature:
          required: true
          pattern: ^sha256=[0-9a-f]{64}$
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatusChanged'
    signature:
      algorithm: hmac-sha256
      header: X-Parcelly-Signature
      format: sha256={hex}
      over: raw_body
      secret: webhook_secret
semantic_mappings:
  spokes_order_status_to_shipment_status:
    paid: CREATED
    shipped: COLLECTED
    delivered: DELIVERED
    cancelled: RETURNED
  shipment_status_to_spokes_order_status:
    CREATED: paid
    COLLECTED: shipped
    IN_TRANSIT: shipped
    RETURNED: cancelled
decisions:
- id: D1
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight_g: A (1-5000g), B (5001-15000g), C (15001-25000g). Mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight_g must be 25001-1000000g. Outside range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D3
  text: Postcode area (first 1-2 letters) must match receiver.address.city. Mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D4
  text: Idempotency-Key longer than 255 characters returns 400 INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. Blank or missing key creates a new shipment each time.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D5
  text: Webhook shipment.status_changed emitted only on genuine status transitions (CREATED→COLLECTED, COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED, IN_TRANSIT→RETURNED). Creating a shipment (status CREATED) does NOT emit a webhook. Re-setting the same status does NOT emit a webhook.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D11
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D14
  text: Pallet type must be EUR. Any other value returns 422 INVALID_PALLET_TYPE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes stores address as single free-text line. Parcelly requires structured fields: street, building, postcode, city, country=GB. Consumer extracts postcode (UK format, last token), city (token before postcode), street+building from remainder. If postcode/city cannot be extracted, fail fast.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D16
  text: 'Spokes stores weight_kg as float. Parcelly requires weight_g integer (grams). Consumer converts: weight_g = round(weight_kg * 1000). Parcel threshold: weight_g ≤ 25000 → parcel (size A/B/C by weight tier); weight_g > 25000 → pallet endpoint. Cargo bikes >25kg use pallet endpoint.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D17
  text: 'Parcel size tier derived from weight_g: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001-15000g, C 15001-25000g. Consumer selects size field accordingly.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D18
  text: Spokes uses handler-based idempotency. Parcelly uses Idempotency-Key header (≤255 chars, scoped per partner). Consumer sends Spokes order reference as Idempotency-Key on shipment creation.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D19
  text: Spokes stores phone numbers in free-text format (e.g., '07700 900200'). Parcelly requires E.164 +447XXXXXXXXX. Consumer normalizes by stripping non-digits, ensuring leading +447, validating 11 digits after +44.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D20
  text: 'Order paid event handlers (ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS) must be idempotent: payment gateway may retry confirmations (second call finds order already paid, keeps original paid_at, calls handlers again). Exception in a handler is logged and does not undo payment; remaining handlers still run.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D21
  text: When order status changes from pending to paid, Spokes creates a Parcelly shipment (parcel or pallet based on weight_g). This happens in an ORDER_PAID_HANDLER and must be idempotent (uses order reference as Idempotency-Key).
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D22
  text: 'Spokes order status lifecycle: pending → paid → shipped → delivered, with cancelled as a branch from pending via support. No automated carrier status; shipped and delivered set manually by warehouse team.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D23
  text: POST /orders/{id}/pay returns 409 ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE if order status not in (pending, paid). Duplicate payment confirmation does not change paid_at; original timestamp preserved.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): use Parcelly's pallet endpoint for >25kg orders."
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)."
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H7
  text: "\"Spokes (consumer) must fix scenarios S1–S4 to reference correct decisions and add missing scenarios for D20, D21, H1, H2, H3, H4. Do you want to do that now? Answer: Yes, I'll fix consumer scenarios and add missing ones in my next turn\""
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H9
  text: 'Please confirm the corrected scenario IDs and titles for S1-S4 and S5. Answer: S1: Consumer normalizes phone number before shipment creation Answer: Yes, confirmed'
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q9
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H10
  text: "S7 scenario uses consumer actions mark_shipped, mark_delivered, cancel_order which aren't defined in the consumer's exposed APIs. Should I add these as internal consumer actions or use the existing order status transitions? Answer: Add as internal consumer actions (they exist in warehouse UI)"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q10
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H11
  text: 'Spokes (consumer) must fix: (1) S1 cites D15 (address parsing) but tests phone normalization (D14/D24). (2) S4 cites D21 (order-paid→shipment) but tests webhook signature+status update. (3) Add missing consumer scenarios for D21 (order-paid triggers shipment), D22 (order lifecycle pending→paid→shipped→delivered, cancelled from pending), D24 (phone normalization). (4) Deduplicate consumer decisions D18/D19 against provider D8/D11. (5) Ensure semantic mapping does not auto-map DELIVERED→delivered (provider fixed mapping). Please address in your next turn. Answer: Will fix all consumer-side issues in next turn'
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q11
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly

decisions:
- id: D1
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight_g: A (1-5000g), B (5001-15000g), C (15001-25000g). Mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight_g must be 25001-1000000g. Outside range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D3
  text: Postcode area (first 1-2 letters) must match receiver.address.city. Mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D4
  text: Idempotency-Key longer than 255 characters returns 400 INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. Blank or missing key creates a new shipment each time.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D5
  text: Webhook shipment.status_changed emitted only on genuine status transitions (CREATED→COLLECTED, COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED, IN_TRANSIT→RETURNED). Creating a shipment (status CREATED) does NOT emit a webhook. Re-setting the same status does NOT emit a webhook.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D11
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D14
  text: Pallet type must be EUR. Any other value returns 422 INVALID_PALLET_TYPE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes stores address as single free-text line. Parcelly requires structured fields: street, building, postcode, city, country=GB. Consumer extracts postcode (UK format, last token), city (token before postcode), street+building from remainder. If postcode/city cannot be extracted, fail fast.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D16
  text: 'Spokes stores weight_kg as float. Parcelly requires weight_g integer (grams). Consumer converts: weight_g = round(weight_kg * 1000). Parcel threshold: weight_g ≤ 25000 → parcel (size A/B/C by weight tier); weight_g > 25000 → pallet endpoint. Cargo bikes >25kg use pallet endpoint.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D17
  text: 'Parcel size tier derived from weight_g: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001-15000g, C 15001-25000g. Consumer selects size field accordingly.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D18
  text: Spokes uses handler-based idempotency. Parcelly uses Idempotency-Key header (≤255 chars, scoped per partner). Consumer sends Spokes order reference as Idempotency-Key on shipment creation.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D19
  text: Spokes stores phone numbers in free-text format (e.g., '07700 900200'). Parcelly requires E.164 +447XXXXXXXXX. Consumer normalizes by stripping non-digits, ensuring leading +447, validating 11 digits after +44.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D20
  text: 'Order paid event handlers (ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS) must be idempotent: payment gateway may retry confirmations (second call finds order already paid, keeps original paid_at, calls handlers again). Exception in a handler is logged and does not undo payment; remaining handlers still run.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D21
  text: When order status changes from pending to paid, Spokes creates a Parcelly shipment (parcel or pallet based on weight_g). This happens in an ORDER_PAID_HANDLER and must be idempotent (uses order reference as Idempotency-Key).
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D22
  text: 'Spokes order status lifecycle: pending → paid → shipped → delivered, with cancelled as a branch from pending via support. No automated carrier status; shipped and delivered set manually by warehouse team.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D23
  text: POST /orders/{id}/pay returns 409 ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE if order status not in (pending, paid). Duplicate payment confirmation does not change paid_at; original timestamp preserved.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): use Parcelly's pallet endpoint for >25kg orders."
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)."
  owner: consumer

- id: H7

  owner: consumer

  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H10
  text: "S7 scenario uses consumer actions mark_shipped, mark_delivered, cancel_order which aren't defined in the consumer's exposed APIs. Should I add these as internal consumer actions or use the existing order status transitions? Answer: Add as internal consumer actions (they exist in warehouse UI)"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q10
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H11
  text: 'Spokes (consumer) must fix: (1) S1 cites D15 (address parsing) but tests phone normalization (D14/D24). (2) S4 cites D21 (order-paid→shipment) but tests webhook signature+status update. (3) Add missing consumer scenarios for D21 (order-paid triggers shipment), D22 (order lifecycle pending→paid→shipped→delivered, cancelled from pending), D24 (phone normalization). (4) Deduplicate consumer decisions D18/D19 against provider D8/D11. (5) Ensure semantic mapping does not auto-map DELIVERED→delivered (provider fixed mapping). Please address in your next turn. Answer: Will fix all consumer-side issues in next turn'
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q11
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H12
  text: 'Which specific scenarios should be modified to fix the consumer decision mismatches? Answer: All of the above'
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q12

doubleblind: '1.0'
id: spokes-parcelly-shipping
version: 30
status: proposed
parties:
  consumer:
    id: spokes
    name: Spokes (bike shop)
  provider:
    id: parcelly
    name: Parcelly (courier)
environments: {}
secrets:
- name: partner_api_key
  description: Partner API key issued by Parcelly
- name: webhook_secret
  description: Secret for webhook signatures
glossary:
  mark_shipped: 'Internal consumer action: called by warehouse UI to transition order from paid → shipped. Triggers Parcelly shipment creation if not already created (idempotent via order reference as Idempotency-Key).'
  mark_delivered: 'Internal consumer action: called by warehouse UI to transition order from shipped → delivered. No carrier integration; status set manually.'
  cancel_order: 'Internal consumer action: called by support to transition order from pending → cancelled. Adds note in helpdesk; no automated carrier return status.'
schemas:
  Address:
    type: object
    required:
    - street
    - building
    - postcode
    - city
    - country
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      street:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      building:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      flat:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      postcode:
        type: string
        pattern: ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$
      city:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 80
      country:
        const: GB
  Receiver:
    type: object
    required:
    - name
    - phone
    - address
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      name:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      phone:
        type: string
        pattern: ^\+447\d{9}$
      address:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Address'
  CreateShipmentRequest:
    type: object
    required:
    - reference
    - receiver
    - parcel
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      reference:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g
        - size
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
  CreatePalletRequest:
    type: object
    required:
    - reference
    - receiver
    - pallet
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      reference:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      pallet:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g
        - pallet_type
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          pallet_type:
            const: EUR
  ShipmentStatus:
    enum:
    - CREATED
    - COLLECTED
    - IN_TRANSIT
    - DELIVERED
    - RETURNED
  Shipment:
    type: object
    required:
    - id
    - service
    - reference
    - status
    - tracking_number
    - price_pence
    - receiver
    - created_at
    - updated_at
    properties:
      id:
        type: string
      service:
        enum:
        - parcel
        - pallet
      reference:
        type: string
      status:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatus'
      tracking_number:
        type: string
      price_pence:
        type: integer
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
      pallet:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
          pallet_type:
            const: EUR
      created_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
      updated_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
  WebhookRegistration:
    type: object
    required:
    - url
    - secret
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      url:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 2000
      secret:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 256
  WebhookEndpoint:
    type: object
    required:
    - url
    - events
    properties:
      url:
        type: string
      events:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
  ShipmentStatusChanged:
    type: object
    required:
    - event
    - shipment_id
    - reference
    - status
    - occurred_at
    properties:
      event:
        const: shipment.status_changed
      shipment_id:
        type: string
      reference:
        type: string
      status:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatus'
      occurred_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
  Error:
    type: object
    required:
    - code
    - message
    properties:
      code:
        type: string
      message:
        type: string
operations:
  create_shipment:
    description: Create a parcel shipment
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: POST
      path: /v1/shipments
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
        Idempotency-Key:
          required: false
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/CreateShipmentRequest'
    responses:
      '201':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Shipment'
      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '422':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 201
      body:
        id: shp_1
        service: parcel
        reference: ORD-1001
        status: CREATED
        tracking_number: PCL1GB
        price_pence: 1299
        receiver:
          name: John Smith
          phone: '+447700900200'
          address:
            street: Long Street
            building: '5'
            flat: '3'
            postcode: E1 6AN
            city: London
            country: GB
        parcel:
          weight_g: 1200
          size: A
        created_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
        updated_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
      idempotent_on_header: Idempotency-Key
  find_shipment:
    description: Most recent shipment with a reference
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: GET
      path: /v1/shipments
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
    responses:
      '200':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Shipment'
      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '404':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 200
      body:
        id: shp_1
        service: parcel
        reference: ORD-1001
        status: IN_TRANSIT
        tracking_number: PCL1GB
        price_pence: 1299
        receiver:
          name: John Smith
          phone: '+447700900200'
          address:
            street: Long Street
            building: '5'
            postcode: E1 6AN
            city: London
            country: GB
        parcel:
          weight_g: 1200
          size: A
        created_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
        updated_at: '2026-10-06T11:00:00.000Z'
  get_shipment:
    description: One shipment
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: GET
      path: /v1/shipments/{id}
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
    responses:
      '200':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Shipment'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '404':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 200
      body:
        id: shp_1
        service: parcel
        reference: ORD-1001
        status: DELIVERED
        tracking_number: PCL1GB
        price_pence: 1299
        receiver:
          name: John Smith
          phone: '+447700900200'
          address:
            street: Long Street
            building: '5'
            postcode: E1 6AN
            city: London
            country: GB
        parcel:
          weight_g: 1200
          size: A
        created_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
        updated_at: '2026-10-06T12:00:00.000Z'
  create_pallet:
    description: Create a pallet shipment
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: POST
      path: /v1/pallets
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
        Idempotency-Key:
          required: false
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/CreatePalletRequest'
    responses:
      '201':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Shipment'
      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '422':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 201
      body:
        id: plt_1
        service: pallet
        reference: ORD-1002
        status: CREATED
        tracking_number: PAL1GB
        price_pence: 8900
        receiver:
          name: Emma Brown
          phone: '+447700900300'
          address:
            street: Corn Street
            building: '1'
            postcode: BS1 1HQ
            city: Bristol
            country: GB
        pallet:
          weight_g: 27000
          pallet_type: EUR
        created_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
        updated_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
      idempotent_on_header: Idempotency-Key
  register_webhook:
    description: Register or replace the partner's webhook endpoint
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: POST
      path: /v1/webhooks
      headers:
        Authorization:
          required: true
          pattern: ^Bearer .+$
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/WebhookRegistration'
    responses:
      '201':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/WebhookEndpoint'
      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 201
      body:
        url: https://shop.example.com/parcelly/webhook
        events:
        - shipment.status_changed
webhooks:
  shipment_status_changed:
    description: Sent when a shipment moves to a different status
    direction: provider_to_consumer
    request:
      method: POST
      url: ${CONSUMER_WEBHOOK_URL}
      headers:
        X-Parcelly-Signature:
          required: true
          pattern: ^sha256=[0-9a-f]{64}$
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatusChanged'
    signature:
      algorithm: hmac-sha256
      header: X-Parcelly-Signature
      format: sha256={hex}
      over: raw_body
      secret: webhook_secret
semantic_mappings:
  spokes_order_status_to_shipment_status:
    paid: CREATED
    shipped: COLLECTED
    delivered: DELIVERED
    cancelled: RETURNED
  shipment_status_to_spokes_order_status:
    CREATED: paid
    COLLECTED: shipped
    IN_TRANSIT: shipped
    RETURNED: cancelled
decisions:
- id: D1
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight_g: A (1-5000g), B (5001-15000g), C (15001-25000g). Mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight_g must be 25001-1000000g. Outside range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D3
  text: Postcode area (first 1-2 letters) must match receiver.address.city. Mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D4
  text: Idempotency-Key longer than 255 characters returns 400 INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. Blank or missing key creates a new shipment each time.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D5
  text: Webhook shipment.status_changed emitted only on genuine status transitions (CREATED→COLLECTED, COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED, IN_TRANSIT→RETURNED). Creating a shipment (status CREATED) does NOT emit a webhook. Re-setting the same status does NOT emit a webhook.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D11
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D14
  text: Pallet type must be EUR. Any other value returns 422 INVALID_PALLET_TYPE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes stores address as single free-text line. Parcelly requires structured fields: street, building, postcode, city, country=GB. Consumer extracts postcode (UK format, last token), city (token before postcode), street+building from remainder. If postcode/city cannot be extracted, fail fast.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D16
  text: 'Spokes stores weight_kg as float. Parcelly requires weight_g integer (grams). Consumer converts: weight_g = round(weight_kg * 1000). Parcel threshold: weight_g ≤ 25000 → parcel (size A/B/C by weight tier); weight_g > 25000 → pallet endpoint. Cargo bikes >25kg use pallet endpoint.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D17
  text: 'Parcel size tier derived from weight_g: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001-15000g, C 15001-25000g. Consumer selects size field accordingly.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D18
  text: Spokes uses handler-based idempotency. Parcelly uses Idempotency-Key header (≤255 chars, scoped per partner). Consumer sends Spokes order reference as Idempotency-Key on shipment creation.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D19
  text: Spokes stores phone numbers in free-text format (e.g., '07700 900200'). Parcelly requires E.164 +447XXXXXXXXX. Consumer normalizes by stripping non-digits, ensuring leading +447, validating 11 digits after +44.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D20
  text: 'Order paid event handlers (ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS) must be idempotent: payment gateway may retry confirmations (second call finds order already paid, keeps original paid_at, calls handlers again). Exception in a handler is logged and does not undo payment; remaining handlers still run.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D21
  text: When order status changes from pending to paid, Spokes creates a Parcelly shipment (parcel or pallet based on weight_g). This happens in an ORDER_PAID_HANDLER and must be idempotent (uses order reference as Idempotency-Key).
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D22
  text: 'Spokes order status lifecycle: pending → paid → shipped → delivered, with cancelled as a branch from pending via support. No automated carrier status; shipped and delivered set manually by warehouse team.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D23
  text: POST /orders/{id}/pay returns 409 ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE if order status not in (pending, paid). Duplicate payment confirmation does not change paid_at; original timestamp preserved.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): use Parcelly's pallet endpoint for >25kg orders."
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)."
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H7
  text: "\"Spokes (consumer) must fix scenarios S1–S4 to reference correct decisions and add missing scenarios for D20, D21, H1, H2, H3, H4. Do you want to do that now? Answer: Yes, I'll fix consumer scenarios and add missing ones in my next turn\""
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H9
  text: 'Please confirm the corrected scenario IDs and titles for S1-S4 and S5. Answer: S1: Consumer normalizes phone number before shipment creation Answer: Yes, confirmed'
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q9
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H10
  text: "S7 scenario uses consumer actions mark_shipped, mark_delivered, cancel_order which aren't defined in the consumer's exposed APIs. Should I add these as internal consumer actions or use the existing order status transitions? Answer: Add as internal consumer actions (they exist in warehouse UI)"
  owner: consumer
  origin_question: Q10
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H11
  text: 'Spokes (consumer) must fix: (1) S1 cites D15 (address parsing) but tests phone normalization (D14/D24). (2) S4 cites D21 (order-paid→shipment) but tests webhook signature+status update. (3) Add missing consumer scenarios for D21 (order-paid triggers shipment), D22 (order lifecycle pending→paid→shipped→delivered, cancelled from pending), D24 (phone normalization). (4) Deduplicate consumer decisions D18/D19 against provider D8/D11. (5) Ensure semantic mapping does not auto-map DELIVERED→delivered (provider fixed mapping). Please address in your next turn. Answer: Will fix all consumer-side issues in next turn'
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q11
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H12
  text: 'Which specific scenarios should be modified to fix the consumer decision mismatches? Answer: All of the above'
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q12
- id: H13
  text: 'Should the semantic mapping for DELIVERED status be changed to prevent automatic order status updates? Answer: Yes, map DELIVERED → pending_delivery'
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q13

doubleblind: '1.0'
id: spokes-parcelly-shipping
version: 31
status: signed
parties:
  consumer:
    id: spokes
    name: Spokes (bike shop)
  provider:
    id: parcelly
    name: Parcelly (courier)
environments: {}
secrets:
- name: partner_api_key
  description: Partner API key issued by Parcelly
- name: webhook_secret
  description: Secret for webhook signatures
glossary:
  mark_shipped: "'Internal consumer action: called by warehouse UI to transition order from paid → shipped. Triggers Parcelly shipment creation if not already created (idempotent via order reference as Idempotency-Key).'"
  mark_delivered: "'Internal consumer action: called by warehouse UI to transition order from shipped → delivered. No carrier integration; status set manually.'"
  cancel_order: "'Internal consumer action: called by support to transition order from pending → cancelled. Adds note in helpdesk; no automated carrier return status.'"
schemas:
  Address:
    type: object
    required:
    - street
    - building
    - postcode
    - city
    - country
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      street:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      building:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      flat:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20

webhooks:
  shipment_status_changed:
    description: Sent when a shipment moves to a different status
    direction: provider_to_consumer
    request:
      method: POST
      url: ${CONSUMER_WEBHOOK_URL}
      headers:
        X-Parcelly-Signature:
          required: true
          pattern: ^sha256=[0-9a-f]{64}$
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatusChanged'
    signature:
      algorithm: hmac-sha256
      header: X-Parcelly-Signature
      format: sha256={hex}
      over: raw_body
      secret: webhook_secret

    IN_TRANSIT: shipped

decisions:
- id: D1
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight_g: A (1-5000g), B (5001-15000g), C (15001-25000g). Mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight_g must be 25001-1000000g. Outside range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D3
  text: Postcode area (first 1-2 letters) must match receiver.address.city. Mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D4
  text: Idempotency-Key longer than 255 characters returns 400 INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. Blank or missing key creates a new shipment each time.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D5
  text: Webhook shipment.status_changed emitted only on genuine status transitions (CREATED→COLLECTED, COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED, IN_TRANSIT→RETURNED). Creating a shipment (status CREATED) does NOT emit a webhook. Re-setting the same status does NOT emit a webhook.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D11
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D14
  text: Pallet type must be EUR. Any other value returns 422 INVALID_PALLET_TYPE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes stores address as single free-text line. Parcelly requires structured fields: street, building, postcode, city, country=GB. Consumer extracts postcode (UK format, last token), city (token before postcode), street+building from remainder. If postcode/city cannot be extracted, fail fast.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D16
  text: 'Spokes stores weight_kg as float. Parcelly requires weight_g integer (grams). Consumer converts: weight_g = round(weight_kg * 1000). Parcel threshold: weight_g ≤ 25000 → parcel (size A/B/C by weight tier); weight_g > 25000 → pallet endpoint. Cargo bikes >25kg use pallet endpoint.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D17
  text: 'Parcel size tier derived from weight_g: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001-15000g, C 15001-25000g. Consumer selects size field accordingly.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D20
  text: 'Order paid event handlers (ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS) must be idempotent: payment gateway may retry confirmations (second call finds order already paid, keeps original paid_at, calls handlers again). Exception in a handler is logged and does not undo payment; remaining handlers still run.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D21
  text: When order status changes from pending to paid, Spokes creates a Parcelly shipment (parcel or pallet based on weight_g). This happens in an ORDER_PAID_HANDLER and must be idempotent (uses order reference as Idempotency-Key).
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D22
  text: 'Spokes order status lifecycle: pending → paid → shipped → delivered, with cancelled as a branch from pending via support. No automated carrier status; shipped and delivered set manually by warehouse team.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D23
  text: POST /orders/{id}/pay returns 409 ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE if order status not in (pending, paid). Duplicate payment confirmation does not change paid_at; original timestamp preserved.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): use Parcelly's pallet endpoint for >25kg orders."
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)."
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H3
  text: Warehouse manually confirms delivery via internal action confirm_delivery (called by warehouse UI). Only after this action does order status become 'delivered'. DELIVERED webhook does NOT auto-update order status.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H4
  text: Semantic mapping shipment_status_to_spokes_order_status must NOT map DELIVERED → delivered. DELIVERED webhook only advances shipment tracking; order delivery requires manual warehouse confirmation (H3).
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly

doubleblind: '1.0'
id: spokes-parcelly-shipping
version: 32
status: proposed
parties:
  consumer:
    id: spokes
    name: Spokes (bike shop)
  provider:
    id: parcelly
    name: Parcelly (courier)
environments: {}
secrets:
- name: partner_api_key
  description: Partner API key issued by Parcelly
- name: webhook_secret
  description: Secret for webhook signatures
glossary:
  mark_shipped: "'Internal consumer action: called by warehouse UI to transition order from paid → shipped. Triggers Parcelly shipment creation if not already created (idempotent via order reference as Idempotency-Key).'"
  mark_delivered: "'Internal consumer action: called by warehouse UI to transition order from shipped → delivered. No carrier integration; status set manually.'"
  cancel_order: "'Internal consumer action: called by support to transition order from pending → cancelled. Adds note in helpdesk; no automated carrier return status.'"
schemas:
  Address:
    type: object
    required:
    - street
    - building
    - postcode
    - city
    - country
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      street:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      building:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      flat:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      postcode:
        type: string
        pattern: ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$
      city:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 80
      country:
        const: GB
  Receiver:
    type: object
    required:
    - name
    - phone
    - address
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      name:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      phone:
        type: string
        pattern: ^\+447\d{9}$
      address:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Address'
  CreateShipmentRequest:
    type: object
    required:
    - reference
    - receiver
    - parcel
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      reference:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g
        - size
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
  CreatePalletRequest:
    type: object
    required:
    - reference
    - receiver
    - pallet
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      reference:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      pallet:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g
        - pallet_type
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          pallet_type:
            const: EUR
  ShipmentStatus:
    enum:
    - CREATED
    - COLLECTED
    - IN_TRANSIT
    - DELIVERED
    - RETURNED
  Shipment:
    type: object
    required:
    - id
    - service
    - reference
    - status
    - tracking_number
    - price_pence
    - receiver
    - created_at
    - updated_at
    properties:
      id:
        type: string
      service:
        enum:
        - parcel
        - pallet
      reference:
        type: string
      status:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatus'
      tracking_number:
        type: string
      price_pence:
        type: integer
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
      pallet:
        type: object
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
          pallet_type:
            const: EUR
      created_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
      updated_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
  WebhookRegistration:
    type: object
    required:
    - url
    - secret
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      url:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 2000
      secret:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 256
  WebhookEndpoint:
    type: object
    required:
    - url
    - events
    properties:
      url:
        type: string
      events:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
  ShipmentStatusChanged:
    type: object
    required:
    - event
    - shipment_id
    - reference
    - status
    - occurred_at
    properties:
      event:
        const: shipment.status_changed
      shipment_id:
        type: string
      reference:
        type: string
      status:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatus'
      occurred_at:
        type: string
        format: date-time
  Error:
    type: object
    required:
    - code
    - message
    properties:
      code:
        type: string
      message:
        type: string
operations:
  create_shipment:
    description: Create a parcel shipment

    request:

        receiver:

    responses:
      '200':
        body:

      '400':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '401':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
      '404':
        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:
      default_status: 200
      body:
        id: shp_1
        service: parcel
        reference: ORD-1001
        status: IN_TRANSIT
        tracking_number: PCL1GB
        price_pence: 1299
        receiver:
          name: John Smith
          phone: '+447700900200'
          address:
            street: Long Street
            building: '5'
            postcode: E1 6AN
            city: London

        parcel:
          weight_g: 1200
          size: A
        created_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'

  get_shipment:

    request:

        body:
          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'

          $ref: '#/schemas/Error'
    stub:

      body:

        status: DELIVERED
        tracking_number: PCL1GB
        price_pence: 1299
        receiver:
          name: John Smith
          phone: '+447700900200'
          address:
            street: Long Street
            building: '5'

            city: London

        parcel:
          weight_g: 1200
          size: A
        created_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
        updated_at: '2026-10-06T12:00:00.000Z'
  create_pallet:
    description: Create a pallet shipment
    direction: consumer_to_provider
    request:
      method: POST
      path: /v1/pallets
      headers:

    responses:

      body:

        receiver:
          name: Emma Brown

          address:

            postcode: BS1 1HQ

        pallet:

          pallet_type: EUR
        created_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'

webhooks:
  shipment_status_changed:
    description: Sent when a shipment moves to a different status
    direction: provider_to_consumer
    request:
      method: POST
      url: ${CONSUMER_WEBHOOK_URL}
      headers:
        X-Parcelly-Signature:
          required: true
          pattern: ^sha256=[0-9a-f]{64}$
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatusChanged'
    signature:
      algorithm: hmac-sha256
      header: X-Parcelly-Signature
      format: sha256={hex}
      over: raw_body
      secret: webhook_secret
semantic_mappings:
  spokes_order_status_to_shipment_status:
    paid: CREATED
    shipped: COLLECTED
    delivered: DELIVERED
    cancelled: RETURNED
  shipment_status_to_spokes_order_status:
    CREATED: paid
    COLLECTED: shipped
    IN_TRANSIT: shipped
    RETURNED: cancelled
decisions:
- id: D1
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight_g: A (1-5000g), B (5001-15000g), C (15001-25000g). Mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight_g must be 25001-1000000g. Outside range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D3
  text: Postcode area (first 1-2 letters) must match receiver.address.city. Mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D4
  text: Idempotency-Key longer than 255 characters returns 400 INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. Blank or missing key creates a new shipment each time.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D5
  text: Webhook shipment.status_changed emitted only on genuine status transitions (CREATED→COLLECTED, COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED, IN_TRANSIT→RETURNED). Creating a shipment (status CREATED) does NOT emit a webhook. Re-setting the same status does NOT emit a webhook.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D11
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D14
  text: Pallet type must be EUR. Any other value returns 422 INVALID_PALLET_TYPE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes stores address as single free-text line. Parcelly requires structured fields: street, building, postcode, city, country=GB. Consumer extracts postcode (UK format, last token), city (token before postcode), street+building from remainder. If postcode/city cannot be extracted, fail fast.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D16
  text: 'Spokes stores weight_kg as float. Parcelly requires weight_g integer (grams). Consumer converts: weight_g = round(weight_kg * 1000). Parcel threshold: weight_g ≤ 25000 → parcel (size A/B/C by weight tier); weight_g > 25000 → pallet endpoint. Cargo bikes >25kg use pallet endpoint.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D17
  text: 'Parcel size tier derived from weight_g: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001-15000g, C 15001-25000g. Consumer selects size field accordingly.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D20
  text: 'Order paid event handlers (ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS) must be idempotent: payment gateway may retry confirmations (second call finds order already paid, keeps original paid_at, calls handlers again). Exception in a handler is logged and does not undo payment; remaining handlers still run.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D21
  text: When order status changes from pending to paid, Spokes creates a Parcelly shipment (parcel or pallet based on weight_g). This happens in an ORDER_PAID_HANDLER and must be idempotent (uses order reference as Idempotency-Key).
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D22
  text: 'Spokes order status lifecycle: pending → paid → shipped → delivered, with cancelled as a branch from pending via support. No automated carrier status; shipped and delivered set manually by warehouse team.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D23
  text: POST /orders/{id}/pay returns 409 ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE if order status not in (pending, paid). Duplicate payment confirmation does not change paid_at; original timestamp preserved.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): use Parcelly's pallet endpoint for >25kg orders."
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)."
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H3
  text: Warehouse manually confirms delivery via internal action confirm_delivery (called by warehouse UI). Only after this action does order status become 'delivered'. DELIVERED webhook does NOT auto-update order status.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H4
  text: Semantic mapping shipment_status_to_spokes_order_status must NOT map DELIVERED → delivered. DELIVERED webhook only advances shipment tracking; order delivery requires manual warehouse confirmation (H3).
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly

doubleblind: '1.0'
id: spokes-parcelly-shipping
version: 33
status: proposed
parties:
  consumer:
    id: spokes
    name: Spokes (bike shop)
  provider:
    id: parcelly
    name: Parcelly (courier)
environments: {}
secrets:
- name: partner_api_key
  description: Partner API key issued by Parcelly
- name: webhook_secret
  description: Secret for webhook signatures
glossary:
  mark_shipped: "'Internal consumer action: called by warehouse UI to transition order from paid → shipped. Triggers Parcelly shipment creation if not already created (idempotent via order reference as Idempotency-Key).'"
  mark_delivered: "'Internal consumer action: called by warehouse UI to transition order from shipped → delivered. No carrier integration; status set manually.'"
  cancel_order: "'Internal consumer action: called by support to transition order from pending → cancelled. Adds note in helpdesk; no automated carrier return status.'"
schemas:
  Address:
    type: object
    required:
    - street
    - building
    - postcode
    - city
    - country
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      street:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      building:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      flat:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      postcode:
        type: string
        pattern: ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$
      city:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 80
      country:
        const: GB
  Receiver:
    type: object
    required:
    - name
    - phone
    - address
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      name:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      phone:
        type: string
        pattern: ^\+447\d{9}$
      address:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Address'
  CreateShipmentRequest:
    type: object
    required:
    - reference
    - receiver
    - parcel
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      reference:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g
        - size
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
  CreatePalletRequest:
    type: object
    required:
    - reference
    - receiver
    - pallet
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      reference:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      pallet:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g

decisions:
- id: D1
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight_g: A (1-5000g), B (5001-15000g), C (15001-25000g). Mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight_g must be 25001-1000000g. Outside range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D3
  text: Postcode area (first 1-2 letters) must match receiver.address.city. Mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D4
  text: Idempotency-Key longer than 255 characters returns 400 INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. Blank or missing key creates a new shipment each time.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D5
  text: Webhook shipment.status_changed emitted only on genuine status transitions (CREATED→COLLECTED, COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED, IN_TRANSIT→RETURNED). Creating a shipment (status CREATED) does NOT emit a webhook. Re-setting the same status does NOT emit a webhook.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D11
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D14
  text: Pallet type must be EUR. Any other value returns 422 INVALID_PALLET_TYPE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes stores address as single free-text line. Parcelly requires structured fields: street, building, postcode, city, country=GB. Consumer extracts postcode (UK format, last token), city (token before postcode), street+building from remainder. If postcode/city cannot be extracted, fail fast.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D16
  text: 'Spokes stores weight_kg as float. Parcelly requires weight_g integer (grams). Consumer converts: weight_g = round(weight_kg * 1000). Parcel threshold: weight_g ≤ 25000 → parcel (size A/B/C by weight tier); weight_g > 25000 → pallet endpoint. Cargo bikes >25kg use pallet endpoint.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D17
  text: 'Parcel size tier derived from weight_g: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001-15000g, C 15001-25000g. Consumer selects size field accordingly.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D20
  text: 'Order paid event handlers (ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS) must be idempotent: payment gateway may retry confirmations (second call finds order already paid, keeps original paid_at, calls handlers again). Exception in a handler is logged and does not undo payment; remaining handlers still run.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D21
  text: When order status changes from pending to paid, Spokes creates a Parcelly shipment (parcel or pallet based on weight_g). This happens in an ORDER_PAID_HANDLER and must be idempotent (uses order reference as Idempotency-Key).
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D22
  text: 'Spokes order status lifecycle: pending → paid → shipped → delivered, with cancelled as a branch from pending via support. No automated carrier status; shipped and delivered set manually by warehouse team.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D23
  text: POST /orders/{id}/pay returns 409 ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE if order status not in (pending, paid). Duplicate payment confirmation does not change paid_at; original timestamp preserved.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): use Parcelly's pallet endpoint for >25kg orders."
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)."
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H3
  text: Warehouse manually confirms delivery via internal action confirm_delivery (called by warehouse UI). Only after this action does order status become 'delivered'. DELIVERED webhook does NOT auto-update order status.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H4
  text: Semantic mapping shipment_status_to_spokes_order_status must NOT map DELIVERED → delivered. DELIVERED webhook only advances shipment tracking; order delivery requires manual warehouse confirmation (H3).
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H10
  text: 'Internal consumer actions: mark_shipped (warehouse UI transitions order paid→shipped, triggers Parcelly shipment creation if not already created, idempotent via order reference as Idempotency-Key), mark_delivered (warehouse UI transitions shipped→delivered, no carrier integration), cancel_order (support transitions pending→cancelled, adds helpdesk note, no automated carrier return).'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly

decisions:
- id: D1
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight_g: A (1-5000g), B (5001-15000g), C (15001-25000g). Mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight_g must be 25001-1000000g. Outside range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D3
  text: Postcode area (first 1-2 letters) must match receiver.address.city. Mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D4
  text: Idempotency-Key longer than 255 characters returns 400 INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. Blank or missing key creates a new shipment each time.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D5
  text: Webhook shipment.status_changed emitted only on genuine status transitions (CREATED→COLLECTED, COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED, IN_TRANSIT→RETURNED). Creating a shipment (status CREATED) does NOT emit a webhook. Re-setting the same status does NOT emit a webhook.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D11
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D14
  text: Pallet type must be EUR. Any other value returns 422 INVALID_PALLET_TYPE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes stores address as single free-text line. Parcelly requires structured fields: street, building, postcode, city, country=GB. Consumer extracts postcode (UK format, last token), city (token before postcode), street+building from remainder. If postcode/city cannot be extracted, fail fast.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D16
  text: 'Spokes stores weight_kg as float. Parcelly requires weight_g integer (grams). Consumer converts: weight_g = round(weight_kg * 1000). Parcel threshold: weight_g ≤ 25000 → parcel (size A/B/C by weight tier); weight_g > 25000 → pallet endpoint. Cargo bikes >25kg use pallet endpoint.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D17
  text: 'Parcel size tier derived from weight_g: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001-15000g, C 15001-25000g. Consumer selects size field accordingly.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D20
  text: 'Order paid event handlers (ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS) must be idempotent: payment gateway may retry confirmations (second call finds order already paid, keeps original paid_at, calls handlers again). Exception in a handler is logged and does not undo payment; remaining handlers still run.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D21
  text: When order status changes from pending to paid, Spokes creates a Parcelly shipment (parcel or pallet based on weight_g). This happens in an ORDER_PAID_HANDLER and must be idempotent (uses order reference as Idempotency-Key).
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D22
  text: 'Spokes order status lifecycle: pending → paid → shipped → delivered, with cancelled as a branch from pending via support. No automated carrier status; shipped and delivered set manually by warehouse team.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D23
  text: POST /orders/{id}/pay returns 409 ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE if order status not in (pending, paid). Duplicate payment confirmation does not change paid_at; original timestamp preserved.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): use Parcelly's pallet endpoint for >25kg orders."
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)."
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H3
  text: Warehouse manually confirms delivery via internal action confirm_delivery (called by warehouse UI). Only after this action does order status become 'delivered'. DELIVERED webhook does NOT auto-update order status.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H4
  text: Semantic mapping shipment_status_to_spokes_order_status must NOT map DELIVERED → delivered. DELIVERED webhook only advances shipment tracking; order delivery requires manual warehouse confirmation (H3).
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H10
  text: 'Internal consumer actions: mark_shipped (warehouse UI transitions order paid→shipped, triggers Parcelly shipment creation if not already created, idempotent via order reference as Idempotency-Key), mark_delivered (warehouse UI transitions shipped→delivered, no carrier integration), cancel_order (support transitions pending→cancelled, adds helpdesk note, no automated carrier return).'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H14
  text: "The provider identified that consumer decisions D18, D19, D24 overlap with provider decisions D8, D11, D12. I've removed D18, D19, D24 from the consumer decisions list and updated scenarios to reference provider decisions instead. Is this deduplication correct? Answer: Yes, deduplication is correct"

  origin_question: Q14

  mark_delivered: "'Internal consumer action: called by warehouse UI to transition order from shipped → delivered. No carrier integration; status set manually.'"

schemas:
  Address:
    type: object
    required:
    - street
    - building
    - postcode
    - city
    - country
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      street:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 120
      building:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      flat:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 20
      postcode:
        type: string
        pattern: ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$
      city:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 80
      country:
        const: GB
  Receiver:
    type: object
    required:
    - name
    - phone
    - address
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      name:

      phone:
        type: string
        pattern: ^\+447\d{9}$

    type: object
    required:

    - receiver
    - parcel

    properties:
      reference:
