        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g
        - size
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          size:
            enum:
            - A
            - B
            - C
  CreatePalletRequest:
    type: object
    required:
    - reference
    - receiver
    - pallet
    additionalProperties: false
    properties:
      reference:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        maxLength: 64
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      pallet:
        type: object
        required:
        - weight_g
        - pallet_type
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          weight_g:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
          pallet_type:
            const: EUR
  ShipmentStatus:
    enum:
    - CREATED
    - COLLECTED
    - IN_TRANSIT
    - DELIVERED
    - RETURNED
  Shipment:
    type: object
    required:
    - id
    - service
    - reference
    - status
    - tracking_number
    - price_pence
    - receiver
    - created_at
    - updated_at
    properties:
      id:
        type: string
      service:
        enum:
        - parcel
        - pallet
      reference:
        type: string
      status:

      tracking_number:
        type: string
      price_pence:
        type: integer
      receiver:
        $ref: '#/schemas/Receiver'
      parcel:

        properties:

decisions:
- id: D1
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight_g: A (1-5000g), B (5001-15000g), C (15001-25000g). Mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight_g must be 25001-1000000g. Outside range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D3
  text: Postcode area (first 1-2 letters) must match receiver.address.city. Mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D4
  text: Idempotency-Key longer than 255 characters returns 400 INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. Blank or missing key creates a new shipment each time.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D5
  text: Webhook shipment.status_changed emitted only on genuine status transitions (CREATED→COLLECTED, COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED, IN_TRANSIT→RETURNED). Creating a shipment (status CREATED) does NOT emit a webhook. Re-setting the same status does NOT emit a webhook.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D11
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D14
  text: Pallet type must be EUR. Any other value returns 422 INVALID_PALLET_TYPE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes stores address as single free-text line. Parcelly requires structured fields: street, building, postcode, city, country=GB. Consumer extracts postcode (UK format, last token), city (token before postcode), street+building from remainder. If postcode/city cannot be extracted, fail fast.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D16
  text: 'Spokes stores weight_kg as float. Parcelly requires weight_g integer (grams). Consumer converts: weight_g = round(weight_kg * 1000). Parcel threshold: weight_g ≤ 25000 → parcel (size A/B/C by weight tier); weight_g > 25000 → pallet endpoint. Cargo bikes >25kg use pallet endpoint.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D17
  text: 'Parcel size tier derived from weight_g: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001-15000g, C 15001-25000g. Consumer selects size field accordingly.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D20
  text: 'Order paid event handlers (ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS) must be idempotent: payment gateway may retry confirmations (second call finds order already paid, keeps original paid_at, calls handlers again). Exception in a handler is logged and does not undo payment; remaining handlers still run.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D21
  text: When order status changes from pending to paid, Spokes creates a Parcelly shipment (parcel or pallet based on weight_g). This happens in an ORDER_PAID_HANDLER and must be idempotent (uses order reference as Idempotency-Key).
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D22
  text: 'Spokes order status lifecycle: pending → paid → shipped → delivered, with cancelled as a branch from pending via support. No automated carrier status; shipped and delivered set manually by warehouse team.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D23
  text: POST /orders/{id}/pay returns 409 ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE if order status not in (pending, paid). Duplicate payment confirmation does not change paid_at; original timestamp preserved.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): use Parcelly's pallet endpoint for >25kg orders."
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)."
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H3
  text: Warehouse manually confirms delivery via internal action confirm_delivery (called by warehouse UI). Only after this action does order status become 'delivered'. DELIVERED webhook does NOT auto-update order status.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H4
  text: Semantic mapping shipment_status_to_spokes_order_status must NOT map DELIVERED → delivered. DELIVERED webhook only advances shipment tracking; order delivery requires manual warehouse confirmation (H3).
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H10
  text: 'Internal consumer actions: mark_shipped (warehouse UI transitions order paid→shipped, triggers Parcelly shipment creation if not already created, idempotent via order reference as Idempotency-Key), mark_delivered (warehouse UI transitions shipped→delivered, no carrier integration), cancel_order (support transitions pending→cancelled, adds helpdesk note, no automated carrier return).'

  text: "The provider identified that consumer decisions D18, D19, D24 overlap with provider decisions D8, D11, D12.   - parcelly

  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D11
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D14
  text: Pallet type must be EUR. Any other value returns 422 INVALID_PALLET_TYPE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes stores address as single free-text line. Parcelly requires structured fields: street, building, postcode, city, country=GB. Consumer extracts postcode (UK format, last token), city (token before postcode), street+building from remainder. If postcode/city cannot be extracted, fail fast.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D16
  text: 'Spokes stores weight_kg as float. Parcelly requires weight_g integer (grams). Consumer converts: weight_g = round(weight_kg * 1000). Parcel threshold: weight_g ≤ 25000 → parcel (size A/B/C by weight tier); weight_g > 25000 → pallet endpoint. Cargo bikes >25kg use pallet endpoint.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D17
  text: 'Parcel size tier derived from weight_g: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001-15000g, C 15001-25000g. Consumer selects size field accordingly.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D20
  text: 'Order paid event handlers (ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS) must be idempotent: payment gateway may retry confirmations (second call finds order already paid, keeps original paid_at, calls handlers again). Exception in a handler is logged and does not undo payment; remaining handlers still run.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D21
  text: When order status changes from pending to paid, Spokes creates a Parcelly shipment (parcel or pallet based on weight_g). This happens in an ORDER_PAID_HANDLER and must be idempotent (uses order reference as Idempotency-Key).
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D22
  text: 'Spokes order status lifecycle: pending → paid → shipped → delivered, with cancelled as a branch from pending via support. No automated carrier status; shipped and delivered set manually by warehouse team.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D23
  text: POST /orders/{id}/pay returns 409 ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE if order status not in (pending, paid). Duplicate payment confirmation does not change paid_at; original timestamp preserved.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): use Parcelly's pallet endpoint for >25kg orders."
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)."
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H3
  text: Warehouse manually confirms delivery via internal action confirm_delivery (called by warehouse UI). Only after this action does order status become 'delivered'. DELIVERED webhook does NOT auto-update order status.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H4
  text: Semantic mapping shipment_status_to_spokes_order_status must NOT map DELIVERED → delivered. DELIVERED webhook only advances shipment tracking; order delivery requires manual warehouse confirmation (H3).
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H10
  text: 'Internal consumer actions: mark_shipped (warehouse UI transitions order paid→shipped, triggers Parcelly shipment creation if not already created, idempotent via order reference as Idempotency-Key), mark_delivered (warehouse UI transitions shipped→delivered, no carrier integration), cancel_order (support transitions pending→cancelled, adds helpdesk note, no automated carrier return).'

webhooks:
  shipment_status_changed:
    description: Sent when a shipment moves to a different status
    direction: provider_to_consumer
    request:
      method: POST
      url: ${CONSUMER_WEBHOOK_URL}
      headers:
        X-Parcelly-Signature:
          required: true
          pattern: ^sha256=[0-9a-f]{64}$
      body:
        $ref: '#/schemas/ShipmentStatusChanged'
    signature:
      algorithm: hmac-sha256
      header: X-Parcelly-Signature
      format: sha256={hex}
      over: raw_body
      secret: webhook_secret
semantic_mappings:
  spokes_order_status_to_shipment_status:
    paid: CREATED
    shipped: COLLECTED
    delivered: DELIVERED
    cancelled: RETURNED
  shipment_status_to_spokes_order_status:
    CREATED: paid
    COLLECTED: shipped
    IN_TRANSIT: shipped
    DELIVERED: shipped
    RETURNED: cancelled
decisions:
- id: D1
  text: 'Parcel size must match weight_g: A (1-5000g), B (5001-15000g), C (15001-25000g). Mismatch returns 422 SIZE_WEIGHT_MISMATCH.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D2
  text: Pallet weight_g must be 25001-1000000g. Outside range returns 422 PALLET_WEIGHT_OUT_OF_RANGE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D3
  text: Postcode area (first 1-2 letters) must match receiver.address.city. Mismatch returns 422 POSTCODE_CITY_MISMATCH.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D4
  text: Idempotency-Key longer than 255 characters returns 400 INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY. Blank or missing key creates a new shipment each time.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D5
  text: Webhook shipment.status_changed emitted only on genuine status transitions (CREATED→COLLECTED, COLLECTED→IN_TRANSIT, IN_TRANSIT→DELIVERED, IN_TRANSIT→RETURNED). Creating a shipment (status CREATED) does NOT emit a webhook. Re-setting the same status does NOT emit a webhook.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D6
  text: Tracking numbers follow format PCL<n>GB for parcel service and PAL<n>GB for pallet service.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D7
  text: 'Parcel pricing: size A = 1299 pence, B = 1599 pence, C = 1999 pence. Pallet pricing: EUR pallet = 8900 pence. Price returned in price_pence field.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D8
  text: Receiver phone must match ^\+447\d{9}$ (UK mobile E.164). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_PHONE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D9
  text: Receiver address postcode must match ^[A-Z]{1,2}\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$ (uppercase, exactly one space). Invalid format returns 422 INVALID_POSTCODE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D10
  text: Receiver address country must be GB. Any other value returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D11
  text: 'Parcelly sends X-Parcelly-Signature: sha256=<hex> computed as HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, webhook_secret). Consumer verifies signature over exact raw request bytes before processing. Invalid signature → return 401.'
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D12
  text: Idempotency keys are scoped to partner. A 4xx response does not store the key, allowing corrected retry with same key.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D13
  text: Reference field max length 64 characters. Receiver name max 120. Address street max 120, building max 20, flat max 20, city max 80.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D14
  text: Pallet type must be EUR. Any other value returns 422 INVALID_PALLET_TYPE.
  owner: provider
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D15
  text: 'Spokes stores address as single free-text line. Parcelly requires structured fields: street, building, postcode, city, country=GB. Consumer extracts postcode (UK format, last token), city (token before postcode), street+building from remainder. If postcode/city cannot be extracted, fail fast.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D16
  text: 'Spokes stores weight_kg as float. Parcelly requires weight_g integer (grams). Consumer converts: weight_g = round(weight_kg * 1000). Parcel threshold: weight_g ≤ 25000 → parcel (size A/B/C by weight tier); weight_g > 25000 → pallet endpoint. Cargo bikes >25kg use pallet endpoint.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D17
  text: 'Parcel size tier derived from weight_g: A ≤ 5000g, B 5001-15000g, C 15001-25000g. Consumer selects size field accordingly.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D20
  text: 'Order paid event handlers (ORDER_PAID_HANDLERS) must be idempotent: payment gateway may retry confirmations (second call finds order already paid, keeps original paid_at, calls handlers again). Exception in a handler is logged and does not undo payment; remaining handlers still run.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D21
  text: When order status changes from pending to paid, Spokes creates a Parcelly shipment (parcel or pallet based on weight_g). This happens in an ORDER_PAID_HANDLER and must be idempotent (uses order reference as Idempotency-Key).
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D22
  text: 'Spokes order status lifecycle: pending → paid → shipped → delivered, with cancelled as a branch from pending via support. No automated carrier status; shipped and delivered set manually by warehouse team.'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: D23
  text: POST /orders/{id}/pay returns 409 ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE if order status not in (pending, paid). Duplicate payment confirmation does not change paid_at; original timestamp preserved.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H1
  text: "For cargo bikes >25kg (e.g., Spokes Haul 2 at 27kg/31.5kg): use Parcelly's pallet endpoint for >25kg orders."
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H2
  text: "For incomplete addresses (e.g., 'Behind the old mill, London' with no clear postcode): fail shipment creation (return error to order paid handler)."
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H3
  text: Warehouse manually confirms delivery via internal action confirm_delivery (called by warehouse UI). Only after this action does order status become 'delivered'. DELIVERED webhook does NOT auto-update order status.
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H4
  text: Semantic mapping shipment_status_to_spokes_order_status must NOT map DELIVERED → delivered. DELIVERED webhook only advances shipment tracking; order delivery requires manual warehouse confirmation (H3).
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H10
  text: 'Internal consumer actions: mark_shipped (warehouse UI transitions order paid→shipped, triggers Parcelly shipment creation if not already created, idempotent via order reference as Idempotency-Key), mark_delivered (warehouse UI transitions shipped→delivered, no carrier integration), cancel_order (support transitions pending→cancelled, adds helpdesk note, no automated carrier return).'
  owner: consumer
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H14
  text: "The provider identified that consumer decisions D18, D19, D24 overlap with provider decisions D8, D11, D12. I've removed D18, D19, D24 from the consumer decisions list and updated scenarios to reference provider decisions instead. Is this deduplication correct? Answer: Yes, deduplication is correct"
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q14
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
- id: H15
  text: "I've added missing consumer scenarios S6 (for D21 - order paid triggers shipment creation) and S7 (for D22 - full order lifecycle with manual delivery confirmation). Are these scenarios complete and correct? Answer: Yes, scenarios are complete"
  owner: provider
  origin_question: Q15
  approved_by:
  - spokes
  - parcelly
setup:
  provider:
  - do:
      party: provider
      action: create_partner
      args:
        name: Test Partner
        api_key: '{{secrets.partner_api_key}}'
  - do:
      party: provider
      action: register_webhook
      args:
        url: '{{capture.url}}'
  consumer: []
scenarios:
- id: P1
  title: Valid parcel creation with idempotency replay returns same shipment
  side: provider
  covers:
  - D4
  - D12
  - D13
  - create_shipment
  steps:
  - send:
      operation: create_shipment
      headers:
        Authorization: Bearer {{secrets.partner_api_key}}
        Idempotency-Key: ORD-1001
      body:
        reference: ORD-1001
        receiver:
          name: John Smith
          phone: '+447700900200'
          address:
            street: Long Street
            building: '5'
            flat: '3'
            postcode: E1 6AN
            city: London
            country: GB
        parcel:
          weight_g: 1200
          size: A
      expect:
        status: 201
      capture:
        shipment_id: $.id
  - send:
      operation: create_shipment
      headers:
        Authorization: Bearer {{secrets.partner_api_key}}
        Idempotency-Key: ORD-1001
      body:
        reference: ORD-1001
        receiver:
          name: John Smith
          phone: '+447700900200'
          address:
            street: Long Street
            building: '5'
            flat: '3'
            postcode: E1 6AN
            city: London
            country: GB
        parcel:
          weight_g: 1200
          size: A
      expect:
        status: 201
        match:
          body.id: '{{ctx.shipment_id}}'
- id: S6
  title: Consumer handles shipment status changed webhook and updates order to shipped
  side: consumer
  covers:
  - D21
  - shipment_status_changed
  steps:
  - do:
      party: consumer
      action: reset
  - do:
      party: consumer
      action: create_order
      args:
        customer_name: Test Customer
        phone: '+447700900200'
        address_line: Long Street Building 5 Flat 3 London E1 6AN
        items:
        - unit_weight_kg: 0.5
          unit_price_pence: 1000
          quantity: 1
  - do:
      party: consumer
      action: pay_order
  - expect_received:
      operation: create_shipment
      count: 1
      match:
        headers.Idempotency-Key: '{{ctx.order_id}}'
        body.reference: '{{ctx.order_id}}'
        body.parcel.size: A
        body.receiver.phone: '+447700900200'
        body.receiver.address.postcode: E1 6AN
        body.receiver.address.city: London
  - emit:
      webhook: shipment_status_changed
      body:
        event: shipment.status_changed
        shipment_id: shp_test_123
        reference: '{{ctx.order_id}}'
        status: COLLECTED
        occurred_at: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z'
      signature: valid
      expect:
        status: 200
  - expect_state:
      party: consumer
      query: order
      match:
        status: shipped
- id: E3
  title: 'End-to-end: order paid triggers shipment creation and status update to shipped upon collection'
  side: e2e
  covers:
  - D21
  - D22
  - create_shipment
  - shipment_status_changed
  steps:
  - do:
      party: consumer
      action: reset
  - do:
      party: consumer
      action: create_order
      args:
        customer_name: Test Customer
        phone: '+447700900200'
        address_line: Long Street Building 5 Flat 3 London E1 6AN
        items:
        - unit_weight_kg: 0.5
          unit_price_pence: 1000
          quantity: 1
  - do:
      party: consumer
      action: pay_order
  - do:
      party: provider
      action: advance_shipment_by_reference
      args:
        reference: '{{ctx.order_id}}'
        to: COLLECTED
  - expect_state:
      party: consumer
      query: order
      match:
        status: shipped
      eventually:
        timeout_s: 10
        interval_s: 0.5

I've analyzed Parcelly's private system model against the current contract. The schemas, operations, webhooks, and secrets are already present and fixed. I'm adding provider-owned decisions for every validation rule, idempotency behavior, webhook emission rules, and semantic mappings needed for the Spokes integration. I'm also adding three provider-side scenarios (P1-P3) covering valid parcel creation with idempotency, validation error cases, and webhook emission on status changes. No consumer scenarios or e2e scenarios yet — those will come from the consumer side.
(Some of my contract changes in this turn did not validate and were dropped; I will propose them again.)

I've analyzed Spokes' order system against Parcelly's API. Key mismatches: phone format (free text vs +447XXXXXXXXX), address structure (single line vs structured fields), weight units (kg float vs g integer), parcel/pallet threshold (25kg), idempotency (handler-based vs Idempotency-Key header), and webhook signature verification. I'm adding consumer-owned decisions for each conversion, consumer scenarios for our edge cases, and 2 e2e scenarios for the main flows. I have 2 business questions about cargo bikes and incomplete addresses.

turns.message: I have identified several critical issues in the contract that need to be resolved before it can be signed. The main problems are: (1) consumer decision mismatches where scenarios cite incorrect decision IDs, (2) missing consumer scenarios for key decisions (D21, D22, D24), (3) missing end-to-end scenarios required by rule 7, (4) duplicate/overlapping decisions that need deduplication, (5) logical errors in E1/E2 regarding shipment status flow, and (6) semantic mapping contradiction with H4 that causes automatic order status updates violating manual confirmation requirements. I need clarification on which specific scenarios and mappings should be modified to address these issues.

The reported gap (S1–S4 calling pay_order without create_order) is already fixed in the current contract v30. All consumer scenarios S1–S5 include a create_order step before pay_order. The internal consumer actions mark_shipped, mark_delivered, cancel_order are already defined in the glossary as internal actions. No provider-side changes are needed.
